description: The Super Bowl ad for A Quiet Place Part II uses a brief, suspenseful clip from the film.  It opens with a close-up of a character's terrified face, quickly transitioning to scenes showing the family's struggle for survival in a post-apocalyptic world filled with unseen creatures.  The sounds of crunching gravel and a baby's cry heighten the tension.  The Paramount Pictures logo appears, emphasizing the studio's association with the thriller.

title: Mulan
description: The 2020 Disney Super Bowl ad for Mulan showcases a montage of scenes from the live-action film.  It highlights Mulan's journey as a warrior, emphasizing her strength, determination, and combat skills.  Quick cuts display action sequences and glimpses of key characters and settings. The ad aims to generate excitement and anticipation for the film's release, focusing on its epic scale and visual spectacle.

title: Hunters
description: The Amazon Prime Video Super Bowl 2020 ad for the series "Hunters" is a fast-paced, action-packed montage. It features Al Pacino as he leads a group of Nazi hunters in a thrilling chase through various settings, punctuated by intense close-ups and dramatic scenes. The ad utilizes quick cuts and suspenseful music to build excitement and intrigue, ultimately culminating in a shot of Pacino aiming a weapon.  The overall effect aims to pique viewer interest in the series, emphasizing its action and mystery.

title: The Secret Kicker
description: The Secret Super Bowl ad features a young, seemingly clumsy kicker unexpectedly making a game-winning field goal.  The focus is on the kicker's self-doubt and surprising success, juxtaposed with the brand's message of overcoming insecurities. The ad uses slow-motion and dramatic close-ups to build suspense.  The kicker's confidence grows alongside his performance, culminating in a celebratory moment. The ad emphasizes the power of self-belief and overcoming challenges.

title: Zero Sugar. Done Right
description: The 2020 Pepsi Zero Sugar Super Bowl commercial features various people enjoying Pepsi Zero Sugar in diverse settings.  It highlights the refreshing taste and emphasizes the 'zero sugar' aspect.  The ad uses quick cuts and upbeat music to showcase different scenarios, including people at work, playing games, and relaxing.  The overall message is that Pepsi Zero Sugar is a delicious and enjoyable beverage for everyone, regardless of their activities or lifestyle.

title: Fixed the Pretzel starring Jonathan Van Ness
original_title: 2020 POP TARTS – Fixed the Pretzel starring Jonathan Van Ness
description: Jonathan Van Ness, the Queer Eye star, hilariously attempts to 'fix' a broken Pop-Tart pretzel.  The pretzel, a Pop-Tart-shaped pastry, is initially misshapen.  Van Ness uses various tools and techniques, with comedic results, ultimately embracing the imperfect pretzel's unique charm. The ad emphasizes the playful, quirky nature of the product and its unexpected twists.

title: Key of Vegas
description: The 2020 Las Vegas Super Bowl ad, "Key of Vegas," uses a cinematic, almost dreamlike style.  It showcases various aspects of Las Vegas entertainment, including dazzling stage shows, vibrant nightlife, and luxurious casinos.  A mysterious key is central to the narrative, unlocking different scenes representing the city's diverse offerings. The overall tone is exciting and aspirational, inviting viewers to experience the thrill of Las Vegas.

title: Everything is Ok
description: The 2020 Trump Super Bowl ad, titled "Everything is Ok," uses a montage of positive imagery interspersed with clips of Donald Trump. It features scenes of American landscapes, families, and celebrations, juxtaposed with shots of Trump giving speeches and interacting with supporters. The overall tone aims to project an image of optimism and strength, associating these feelings with the Trump presidency. The ad does not explicitly mention any specific products or services, using visual imagery to convey a message of national pride and well-being.

title: George
description: The ad features a man named George, portrayed by actor Bill Murray, who initially seems to be struggling with everyday tasks.  He's shown fumbling with technology and experiencing minor inconveniences.  However, the narrative subtly shifts to showcase the positive impact of Bloomberg's policies, implying that these seemingly small issues are part of larger societal concerns that Bloomberg aims to address. The overall tone is lighthearted and observational, concluding with the Bloomberg campaign logo.

title: #MakeSpaceForWomen
description: The Olay Super Bowl 2020 ad, #MakeSpaceForWomen, features a montage of women in various fields, interspersed with shots of the Olay product.  The overall message centers on celebrating women's achievements and advocating for greater female representation in leadership roles.  It uses empowering visuals and a strong soundtrack to promote a feeling of female empowerment and solidarity, subtly tying the brand to this message through product placement.

title: Discovers Water On Mars
description: The SodaStream Super Bowl 2020 ad depicts a humorous scenario where NASA scientists excitedly celebrate discovering water on Mars, only to be immediately deflated by an astronaut revealing he brought a SodaStream device to create his own sparkling water. The ad highlights the convenience and resourcefulness of SodaStream, contrasting the monumental discovery with the simple act of making carbonated water. The comedic timing and unexpected twist emphasize the brand's ease of use and portability.

title: BeforeAlexa
description: The Amazon 'Before Alexa' Super Bowl ad depicts a humorous and nostalgic look at life before the smart assistant.  It shows various scenarios of people struggling with everyday tasks—searching for information in encyclopedias, setting alarm clocks manually, and playing music with bulky equipment.  The ad highlights the inconveniences of the past to contrast with the ease and efficiency Alexa provides, culminating in a final shot of someone effortlessly interacting with the device.

title: No We Don’t Charge Annual Fees
original_title: 2020 DISCOVER – No We Don’t Charge Annual Fees
description: The 2020 Discover Super Bowl ad uses humor to highlight the absence of annual fees on their credit cards.  The commercial features a series of scenarios where people are unexpectedly charged annual fees for various absurd things, like a child's drawing or a single grape.  The comedic situations contrast sharply with the simplicity of Discover's fee-free policy, ultimately driving home the message that Discover doesn't charge annual fees, unlike the outlandish examples presented.

title: Password Paradise
description: The DashLane Super Bowl ad, "Password Paradise," depicts a man's idyllic, seemingly perfect life, constantly interrupted by the need to remember countless passwords.  His frustration escalates comically as he struggles with increasingly complex and ridiculous password requirements. The ad highlights the inconvenience and security risks of managing numerous passwords, ultimately leading to the introduction of DashLane as the solution to this problem. The paradise setting contrasts sharply with the reality of password management stress.

title: Inside Post’s Brain
original_title: 2020 BUD LIGHT SELTZER – Inside Post’s Brain
description: The 2020 Bud Light Seltzer Super Bowl commercial, "Inside Post Malone's Brain," uses a surreal, comedic approach.  It depicts Post Malone's internal world as a vibrant, bizarre landscape where his thoughts manifest as abstract imagery and quirky scenarios involving his own clones.  He navigates this internal landscape while enjoying Bud Light Seltzer, highlighting the drink's refreshing nature amidst the chaos. The ad's humor derives from the juxtaposition of Post Malone's celebrity persona and the whimsical, unexpected events in his 'brain'.

title: The Cool Ranch with Lil Nas X and Sam Elliott
original_title: 2020 DORITOS – The Cool Ranch with Lil Nas X and Sam Elliott
description: The Doritos Super Bowl ad features Lil Nas X and Sam Elliott in a Western-themed showdown.  Lil Nas X, riding a horse, encounters Sam Elliott, who's enjoying a bag of Cool Ranch Doritos. A brief standoff ensues, culminating in a dance-off between the two, showcasing the satisfying crunch of the chips.  The commercial highlights the unexpected pairing and the enjoyable taste of Cool Ranch Doritos, ending with both men sharing the snack.

title: Fix the World
description: The 2020 Snickers Super Bowl commercial, "Fix the World," depicts a dystopian future where everyday problems are exaggerated.  A man attempts to fix a broken world with absurd solutions using everyday objects.  The humor lies in the contrast between the serious problems and his ridiculous attempts at fixing them.  Ultimately, it's revealed he's just acting strangely due to hunger, and a Snickers bar solves the problem, restoring normalcy. The ad uses dark humor and satire to highlight the power of a simple Snickers to improve one's mood and outlook.

title: Tough Never Quits
description: The 2020 KIA Super Bowl commercial, "Tough Never Quits," showcases various individuals overcoming challenges in their respective fields.  It features a diverse cast including a young girl learning to skateboard, a construction worker, a basketball player, and a nurse, all demonstrating resilience and determination.  The ad interweaves these stories with shots of the KIA Telluride SUV, subtly associating the vehicle with strength and perseverance. The overall message is inspirational, highlighting the human spirit's ability to overcome adversity.

title: Find The Goodness
description: The Heinz Super Bowl 2020 ad, "Find The Goodness," uses a montage of everyday moments and simple pleasures, intercut with shots of Heinz ketchup being used in various ways.  The ad emphasizes the feeling of finding happiness in small things and connects those feelings to the familiar comfort of Heinz ketchup. It's a feel-good commercial highlighting the brand's association with simple joys and shared experiences, rather than focusing on a specific product feature or innovation.

title: All People Are Tax People
original_title: 2020 TURBOTAX – All People Are Tax People
description: The TurboTax Super Bowl 2020 ad depicts a diverse group of people in various everyday situations, highlighting that taxes affect everyone.  It uses quick cuts and upbeat music to show relatable scenarios, from a dog walker to a professional athlete, all preparing their taxes with TurboTax.  The ad emphasizes simplicity and accessibility of the TurboTax platform for all, regardless of income or profession. The overall message is that tax preparation is a shared experience, making it less daunting.

title: Let It Go
description: The Audi Super Bowl 2020 commercial, "Let It Go," features a young girl confidently driving a sleek, futuristic Audi e-tron through a snowy landscape.  The car's advanced technology allows her to effortlessly navigate challenging terrain.  The ad emphasizes the car's capabilities and its smooth, quiet operation.  The overall tone is optimistic and forward-looking, highlighting the e-tron's innovative features and connection to nature.  The girl's calm demeanor contrasts with the powerful performance of the vehicle.

title: Famous Visitors
description: The 2020 Walmart Super Bowl commercial, "Famous Visitors," features a diverse group of celebrities unexpectedly showing up at a Walmart.  The ad uses humor to showcase the wide variety of products available at Walmart, implying that everyone, regardless of fame, shops there. Celebrities include the NFL's Marshawn Lynch and the Jonas Brothers, among others.  The overall message is that Walmart caters to a wide range of customers and needs.

title: Can’t Touch This
description: The 2020 Cheetos Super Bowl commercial, "Can't Touch This," features a young boy who is so obsessed with Cheetos dust on his hands that he refuses to wash them.  His antics escalate throughout the ad, culminating in various humorous scenarios where his cheesy hands cause chaos and disruption at a formal event, a baseball game, and even a historical reenactment.  The ad ends with the tagline emphasizing the irresistible nature of Cheetos dust.

title: Love Takes Action
original_title: 2020 NEW YORK LIFE – Love Takes Action
description: The New York Life Super Bowl 2020 ad, "Love Takes Action," showcases heartwarming real-life stories of people demonstrating love and support for their families.  It features diverse families facing various challenges – a father and son rebuilding after a natural disaster, a young girl supporting her mother facing health issues, and others. The ad emphasizes the importance of family, resilience, and the role of life insurance in providing financial security during difficult times. The commercial culminates with the New York Life logo and tagline, highlighting their commitment to helping families navigate life's challenges.

title: As Good As The Original
original_title: 2020 MTN DEW ZERO SUGAR – As Good As The Original
description: The MTN DEW ZERO SUGAR Super Bowl ad from 2020, titled "As Good As The Original," features a series of quick-cut scenes showcasing people enjoying the soda in various settings.  The overall tone is energetic and playful, emphasizing the refreshing nature of the drink.  There's no central narrative or storyline, instead relying on vibrant visuals and fast-paced editing to convey the message that the zero-sugar version is just as satisfying as the original.  The ad's primary focus is on the taste and appeal of the product itself.

title: Going Away Party with John Legend and Chrissy Teigen

title: Rock

The stand unexpectedly lands perfectly on a Reese's Take5 candy bar, resulting in a satisfying crunch sound.  The camera focuses on the broken candy bar before cutting to a close-up of the satisfied singer and the Reese's Take5 logo.

title: Loretta
description: The Google ad, "Loretta," showcases a heartwarming story of a woman named Loretta using Google Assistant throughout her life.  The ad uses a montage of photos and videos spanning Loretta's life, highlighting various moments and the role Google Assistant plays in keeping her connected to family and memories.  It emphasizes the personal and emotional connection users can have with technology, subtly suggesting a sense of longevity and companionship offered by the Google Assistant.

title: Best Thing Since Sliced Bread
original_title: 2020 LITTLE CAESARS – Best Thing Since Sliced Bread
description: The Little Caesars 2020 Super Bowl ad, "Best Thing Since Sliced Bread," uses humor to showcase their Hot-N-Ready pizza.  The commercial features a diverse cast of people reacting with exaggerated delight to the pizza's convenience and affordability.  A montage of quick scenes shows various scenarios where people excitedly grab Little Caesars pizzas, emphasizing the speed and ease of purchase. The ad culminates in a playful, celebratory atmosphere, highlighting the pizza as a simple pleasure accessible to everyone.

title: Jimmy Works It Out
original_title: 2020 MICHELOB ULTRA – Jimmy Works It Out
description: The ad features comedian Jimmy Fallon working out in a gym, interspersed with scenes of him achieving various athletic feats seemingly enhanced by drinking Michelob Ultra.  The humor comes from the contrast between Fallon's comedic persona and the serious athleticism portrayed, highlighting the beer's purported light and refreshing nature.  The overall message is that even intense workouts can be complemented with a light, low-calorie drink.

title: Be The One with Katie Sowers

title: Rick and Morty
description: The Pringles Rick and Morty Super Bowl ad features Rick and Morty trapped in a Pringles can.  Rick attempts to use science to escape, but repeatedly fails, highlighting the addictive nature of Pringles' unique stackable chips.  The humor relies on the characters' typical cynical and absurd behavior within the confined space of the can.  The ad ends with a comical, unsatisfying escape attempt.

title: Winona in Winona
description: The Squarespace Super Bowl ad features actress Winona Ryder returning to her hometown of Winona, Minnesota.  The ad showcases various local businesses using Squarespace websites, highlighting the platform's ease of use and effectiveness in building a professional online presence.  Ryder interacts with community members and emphasizes the platform's ability to help small businesses thrive. The overall tone is lighthearted and emphasizes community support.

title: 6 for 6-Pack
description: The 2020 Michelob Ultra Pure Gold Super Bowl commercial, "6 for 6-Pack," features six prominent athletes – Serena Williams, Tony Romo, Peyton Manning, Alex Morgan, Brooks Koepka, and Jimmy Butler –  enjoying a relaxing post-game round of golf. The ad emphasizes the refreshing nature of the drink within a setting of friendly competition and camaraderie, showcasing the beer as a celebratory beverage for athletes' post-game relaxation.

title: Lucky Dog
description: The WeatherTech Super Bowl 2020 ad, "Lucky Dog," features a golden retriever puppy experiencing various mishaps – spilling food, getting muddy, and having accidents.  Throughout, the focus remains on the protective qualities of WeatherTech floor mats and liners, showcasing their ability to contain messes and keep the car clean despite the dog's playful antics.  The ad ends with the dog comfortably resting on a clean floor mat. The overall tone is lighthearted and emphasizes product functionality.

title: Smaht Pahk
description: The 2020 Hyundai Smaht Pahk Super Bowl commercial features Boston Red Sox legend, David Ortiz, showcasing the car's smart park assist feature.  Ortiz struggles to parallel park a Hyundai in a tight Boston street, narrating his challenges with a thick Boston accent.  The ad highlights the ease and precision of the smart park assist, contrasting Ortiz's comical parking attempts with the technology's effortless parking capabilities.  The humor relies on Ortiz's personality and the relatable struggle of parallel parking.

title: Shopping Network with Molly Ringwald
original_title: 2020 AVOCADOS FROM MEXICO – Shopping Network with Molly Ringwald
description: The 2020 Avocados From Mexico Super Bowl commercial parodies a late-night shopping network, hosted by Molly Ringwald.  Ringwald enthusiastically promotes various avocado-related products and recipes, showcasing their versatility.  The humorous ad uses quick cuts, upbeat music, and Ringwald's comedic timing to highlight the deliciousness and convenience of avocados.  It emphasizes the ease of incorporating avocados into everyday meals, offering a lighthearted and entertaining approach to advertising.

title: Typical American
description: The Budweiser 2020 Super Bowl ad, "Typical American," showcases a diverse range of individuals across various professions and backgrounds, highlighting their contributions to American society.  The ad uses a montage style, intercutting shots of everyday Americans working hard, playing with their families, and enjoying life.  It concludes with the Budweiser logo and tagline, subtly emphasizing the brand's association with American values and shared experiences.

title: Road Trip
description: The Planters Mr. Peanut goes on a road trip with a young boy, encountering various humorous situations along the way.  The trip involves unexpected detours, quirky roadside attractions, and comical mishaps, showcasing Mr. Peanut's adventurous and playful personality.  The ad culminates with Mr. Peanut and the boy enjoying some Planters peanuts together, highlighting the snack's role in creating fun memories.

title: Dad?
description: The 2019 T-Mobile Super Bowl ad, "Dad?", features a daughter video-calling her father, who is initially unresponsive due to poor cell service in a remote, mountainous area.  Frustrated, she ultimately reaches him via T-Mobile's improved network coverage.  The ad highlights the expanded network's ability to connect people in previously unreachable locations, emphasizing the emotional connection between father and daughter.  Humorous elements arise from the father's obliviousness to the calls and the daughter's escalating frustration.

brand: CBS FILMS – SCARY STORIES TO TELL IN THE DARK
title: Red Spot
original_title: 2019 CBS FILMS – Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark – Red Spot
description: The ad opens on a girl applying lipstick, then quickly cuts to a series of creepy, quick shots.  A shadowy figure appears in a mirror.  A hand reaches out from under a bed.  A girl is looking at a scary storybook.  The ad ends with the title card and release date for the film 'Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark'.  It's a montage of jump scares and unsettling imagery designed to promote the horror film.

brand: CBS FILMS – SCARY STORIES TO TELL IN THE DARK
title: Big Toe
original_title: 2019 CBS FILMS – Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark – Big Toe
description: The Super Bowl ad for "Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark" opens with a young girl reading a scary story.  A disturbing image of a giant toe appears on the page. The toe then seemingly comes to life, reaching menacingly towards the camera. The ad uses jump scares and creepy visuals to promote the film's horror theme.  It ends with the movie title and release date, creating a sense of suspense and anticipation.

brand: CBS FILMS – SCARY STORIES TO TELL IN THE DARK
title: Jangly Man
original_title: 2019 CBS FILMS – Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark – Jangly Man

The ad quickly flashes the movie title, "Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark," and release date.  The overall tone is frightening and short, designed to pique viewers' interest in the horror film.

title: A Coke is a Coke
original_title: 2019 COCA-COLA – A Coke is a Coke
description: The 2019 Coca-Cola Super Bowl ad, "A Coke is a Coke," shows diverse people from various backgrounds and walks of life all enjoying a Coca-Cola.  The ad emphasizes the unifying power of the simple act of sharing a Coke, highlighting the shared human experience regardless of differences. It features uplifting music and showcases heartwarming moments of connection between individuals, promoting a sense of unity and togetherness.

title: Eat Like Andy
description: The 2019 Burger King Super Bowl ad, "Eat Like Andy," features Andy Carroll, a professional soccer player, showcasing his unusual eating habits.  The ad humorously contrasts Carroll's massive food intake with the relatively smaller size of Burger King's Whopper.  It uses comedic exaggeration to highlight the Whopper's size, despite Carroll's enormous appetite. The commercial primarily focuses on the visual juxtaposition of Carroll's consumption and the Whopper.

title: Trojan Horse Occupants
description: The 2019 Bud Light Super Bowl ad, "Trojan Horse Occupants," depicts a group of unsuspecting partygoers who discover a giant Trojan horse at their gathering.  The horse opens, revealing a horde of people dressed as gladiators who proceed to playfully brawl with the partygoers. The ad highlights the brand's association with fun and lighthearted revelry, culminating in everyone enjoying Bud Light together.

title: The Coach Who Wouldn’t Be Here
original_title: 2019 VERIZON – The Coach Who Wouldn’t Be Here
description: The Verizon Super Bowl 2019 ad tells the story of a football coach who, due to his commitment to family, refuses lucrative coaching opportunities.  The ad focuses on his dedication to his daughter's soccer game and contrasts the high-pressure world of professional sports with the simple joys of family life. It highlights Verizon's reliable network connectivity, implying it enables this balance.  The ad ends with the daughter scoring a goal, reinforcing the importance of family moments.

title: Medieval Barbers
description: The 2019 Bud Light Super Bowl ad, "Medieval Barbers," depicts a comedic scene in a medieval-themed barbershop.  A king receives an unexpectedly modern haircut from a surprisingly skilled barber.  The humor arises from the juxtaposition of the medieval setting with contemporary hair styling techniques and the king's reactions. The ad concludes with the Bud Light logo and tagline.

title: Our Planet
description: The Netflix Super Bowl 2019 ad for "Our Planet" showcases breathtaking footage of diverse wildlife and natural landscapes.  The visuals emphasize the beauty and fragility of the planet's ecosystems.  David Attenborough's voiceover narrates the stunning scenes, highlighting the impact of human activity and urging viewers to protect the environment.  The ad concludes with the Netflix logo and a call to action to watch "Our Planet."

title: We’re Here For You Free Lyft
original_title: 2019 T-MOBILE – We’re Here For You Free Lyft

A woman is stuck on a rollercoaster, a man is surrounded by aggressive chickens, and another is stranded in a desert.  Unexpectedly, a Lyft car appears, driven by a T-Mobile employee offering a free ride, highlighting T-Mobile's customer-centric approach and reliable service. The ad emphasizes the convenience and helpfulness of T-Mobile, using humor to showcase different scenarios where their services could be useful.

title: #NFL100
description: The 2019 NFL Super Bowl ad, titled '#NFL100', is a montage celebrating the league's centennial.  It features rapid cuts showcasing iconic moments, legendary players, and memorable plays throughout NFL history. The visuals are dynamic and energetic, accompanied by an uplifting and powerful musical score.  The ad aims to evoke nostalgia and celebrate the league's legacy and impact on American culture.  No specific product is advertised; the NFL itself is the focus.

title: Wizard
description: The 2019 Toyota Supra Super Bowl ad, titled "Wizard," features a young man transforming into a wizard to effortlessly maneuver through traffic and obstacles.  The transformation is visually striking, highlighting the car's sleek design and powerful performance.  He uses his newfound magical abilities to enhance his driving, showcasing the Supra's agility and speed. The ad ends with the Toyota Supra logo and tagline.

title: RoboChild
description: The TurboTax Live Super Bowl 2019 ad, titled "RoboChild," features a child-like robot navigating a complex tax situation.  The robot struggles with confusing tax forms, highlighting the difficulty of self-filing taxes.  A human tax expert appears, offering assistance via video chat.  The ad emphasizes the ease and convenience of TurboTax Live's expert assistance in resolving complex tax problems, contrasting the robot's struggle with the human expert's capability.

title: Fear Is Everywhere
description: The SimpliSafe 2019 Super Bowl ad, "Fear Is Everywhere," depicts various everyday scenarios where people experience fear – a woman walking home alone at night, a family asleep in their home, and a person working late in an office.  The ad emphasizes the pervasive nature of fear and subtly showcases SimpliSafe's home security system as a solution, culminating in a shot of the system's control panel with the tagline 'SimpliSafe. Security for the things that matter.'  The visuals are dark and suspenseful, building tension before offering the product as a solution.

title: What’s for Dinner? Taco Bell x T-Mobile
original_title: 2019 T-MOBILE – What’s for Dinner? Taco Bell x T-Mobile

A man struggles with limited data, preventing him from ordering Taco Bell.  He then switches to T-Mobile's unlimited data plan, transforming his life and allowing him to finally enjoy Taco Bell.  The ad uses humor and exaggerated scenarios to highlight the benefits of unlimited data.

title: The Deep Clean Level
original_title: 2019 PERSIL PROCLEAN – The Deep Clean Level

The ad uses slow-motion shots and intense music to heighten the drama and emphasizes the product's ability to tackle tough stains.

title: Game of Thrones Joust

title: Captain Marvel

The overall tone is action-oriented and designed to generate excitement.

title: We’ll Keep This Brief

The ad utilizes quick cuts and comedic timing to highlight the speed and efficiency of the network, contrasting it with the inconvenience and frustration often associated with slow internet. title: Special Delivery
description: The 2019 Bud Light Super Bowl ad, "Special Delivery," follows a delivery driver navigating various absurd obstacles to deliver a Bud Light to a customer.  He encounters a runaway llama, a dog-sledding team, and a precarious mountain climb, all while maintaining a surprisingly calm demeanor. The humor lies in the escalating absurdity of the situations and the driver's unflappable resolve to deliver the beer, showcasing the lengths Bud Light is (jokingly) willing to go to for its customers.

title: The Handmaid’s Tale: Season 3

title: Avengers: Endgame

The family's cheerful facade crumbles as disturbing glimpses of doppelgangers and menacing figures are interwoven with shots of the film's title. The ad effectively builds suspense and intrigue, leaving the viewer with a sense of unease and anticipation for the movie's release.

title: Give It Everything
description: The 2019 Kia Telluride Super Bowl ad, "Give It Everything," showcases a family's adventurous journey across diverse landscapes. The family experiences scenic beauty and bonding moments throughout their trip, culminating in a feeling of accomplishment and connection. The focus is on family togetherness and the vehicle's reliability in varied conditions.

title: Artificial Devices Fumble
description: The 2019 Michelob Super Bowl ad, "Artificial Devices Fumble," showcases a series of comical mishaps involving robots attempting to perform various tasks associated with enjoying a beer, like opening a bottle or grilling.  The robots consistently fail hilariously, contrasting their advanced technology with simple human actions.  The ad culminates with a human effortlessly enjoying a Michelob Ultra, highlighting the ease and pleasure of the simple things in life.

It features a montage of scenes depicting a fantastical amusement park filled with talking animals, thrilling rides, and a young girl's imagination. The ad aims to excite viewers about the film's colorful world and adventure, highlighting its family-friendly nature and imaginative storytelling. The overall tone is upbeat and playful, focusing on visual appeal to draw audiences to theaters.

title: Celebration
description: The 2019 Jim Beam Super Bowl ad, "Celebration," shows diverse groups of people – families, friends, and individuals – joyfully celebrating various life moments.  The common thread is the presence of Jim Beam, subtly integrated into each scene.  The ad emphasizes the shared experience of celebration and connection, rather than focusing on specific product features. The overall tone is upbeat and positive, showcasing the brand as a celebratory companion.

title: Job Search for Veterans
description: The Google Super Bowl 2019 ad showcases veterans using Google's job search tools to find employment.  It features several veterans in various settings, highlighting their skills and experiences.  The ad emphasizes Google's commitment to helping veterans transition into civilian life by providing effective and easy-to-use job search resources.  The overall tone is positive and uplifting, focusing on the veterans' resilience and success.

title: Hobbs & Shaw
description: The Super Bowl ad for Hobbs & Shaw features fast-paced action sequences showcasing Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson and Jason Statham.  It highlights their characters' contrasting personalities and their unlikely partnership. The trailer intercuts explosive fight scenes, car chases, and moments of witty banter.  The overall tone is action-packed and humorous, emphasizing the film's over-the-top nature and the stars' charisma.  The ad culminates in a shot of the film's title and release date.

title: 100 Billion Words
description: The Google 2019 Super Bowl ad, "100 Billion Words," showcases the vast amount of data Google processes daily.  It begins with a montage of diverse people using Google services. The ad then transitions to show how Google uses this data to understand and answer diverse searches. It emphasizes the scale and personal nature of Google's information processing, highlighting the power of search in connecting people and information.  The overall tone is positive and emphasizes Google's global reach and impact.

title: CupFone
description: The WeatherTech CupFone Super Bowl ad showcases the product's functionality through a series of humorous scenarios.  A phone is secured in the CupFone, surviving various car mishaps, including a bumpy ride and a sudden stop. The ad emphasizes the CupFone's ability to keep phones secure and accessible, highlighting its practicality and durability with a lighthearted tone.  The comedic situations and a satisfyingly secure phone underscore the product's value proposition.

title: Karlie Kloss
description: Supermodel Karlie Kloss stars in this Wix Super Bowl ad.  The ad showcases Kloss's entrepreneurial journey, highlighting her use of Wix to build her website, showcasing various aspects of her personal brand.  It emphasizes the ease and effectiveness of Wix's website building platform through quick cuts showing different sections of her website and features a montage of her life and career. The overall message promotes Wix as a user-friendly tool for anyone looking to establish an online presence.

title: Feel Free to Come Alive
original_title: 2019 NORWEGIAN CRUISE LINES – Feel Free to Come Alive
description: The 2019 Norwegian Cruise Lines Super Bowl ad, "Feel Free to Come Alive," showcases diverse individuals enjoying various cruise activities.  The scenes quickly cut between people zip-lining, dancing, eating, and relaxing on a cruise ship.  It emphasizes the freedom and excitement of a cruise vacation, contrasting everyday routines with the vibrant, adventurous atmosphere onboard.  The overall message is one of liberation and experiencing life to the fullest.

title: Wide Fit with Howie Long
original_title: 2019 SKECHERS SPORT – Wide Fit with Howie Long
description: The Skechers Sport Super Bowl ad features former NFL player Howie Long showcasing the brand's wide-fit shoes.  The commercial uses humor as Long, known for his large frame, comedically struggles to find shoes that fit until he discovers Skechers' wide fit options. The ad emphasizes comfort and a wide range of sizes, highlighting the brand's inclusivity.  It ends with Long confidently walking in his new Skechers, demonstrating the comfort and fit.

title: Bublé
description: The 2019 Pepsi Bubly Super Bowl commercial features Michael Bublé as a bubbly-obsessed barista who, through various humorous scenarios, uses the beverage to enhance everyday moments and interactions.  The ad showcases Bublé's charm and comedic timing, employing slapstick humor and whimsical visuals to promote the lighthearted nature of the drink.  It culminates in a group singalong to a Bublé-esque version of the Pepsi Bubly jingle.

title: Robot Analogy
description: The 2019 Sprint Super Bowl ad uses a humorous robot analogy to illustrate the frustrations of slow internet and the benefits of Sprint's faster network.  The ad shows various people experiencing technological difficulties, mirrored by robots performing the same tasks clumsily.  The contrast highlights the speed and efficiency offered by Sprint, ultimately showcasing their network's superiority over competitors.  The ad concludes with the Sprint logo and tagline, emphasizing their speed and reliability.

title: In Her Court with Serena Williams
original_title: 2019 BUMBLE – In Her Court with Serena Williams
description: The Bumble Super Bowl 2019 ad, "In Her Court," features Serena Williams playfully using the dating app.  The ad shows various scenarios of women taking control and initiating contact with men, subverting traditional dating dynamics.  Serena's witty narration highlights Bumble's empowering message for women. The overall tone is lighthearted and humorous, emphasizing the app's ease of use and potential for connection.

title: Cashew
description: The 2019 Audi Super Bowl ad, "Cashew," depicts a young girl's journey from childhood to adulthood, narrated by her father.  The narrative is interwoven with scenes showing the evolution of Audi's vehicle design and technology. The ad emphasizes the lasting relationship between father and daughter and subtly connects it to the longevity and reliability of the Audi brand.  The overall tone is heartwarming and nostalgic, focusing on the passage of time and the enduring quality of both familial bonds and Audi cars.

title: Hanna Season 1
description: The Amazon Studios Super Bowl LIII ad for Hanna Season 1 uses a fast-paced montage of intense action scenes.  It showcases snippets of the show's plot, highlighting the protagonist Hanna's exceptional fighting skills and her dangerous life on the run.  The trailer emphasizes the suspenseful and action-packed nature of the series, with quick cuts of chases, fights, and dramatic confrontations, leaving the audience wanting more.  The Amazon Prime Video logo is prominently displayed.

title: We All Win
description: The 2019 Microsoft Super Bowl ad, "We All Win," showcases diverse individuals using Microsoft technology to achieve their goals.  It features a montage of people from different backgrounds—a young girl coding, a musician creating music, a family connecting remotely—all empowered by Microsoft products. The ad emphasizes inclusivity and the positive impact of technology on everyday life, culminating in a message of shared success and empowerment.  It uses uplifting music and quick cuts to highlight various scenarios.

title: Scout
description: The WeatherTech Super Bowl LIII commercial, "Scout," depicts a young boy's imaginative journey as he uses his WeatherTech floor mats as a makeshift boat and sails around his house. The scene transitions between reality and fantasy as he navigates through various obstacles, encountering pirates and a fantastical island.  The ad emphasizes the durability and water resistance of the floor mats through playful storytelling, culminating in a triumphant return to his room.  The overall tone is lighthearted and adventurous.

title: Say the Word
description: The Mercedes-Benz Super Bowl 2019 ad, "Say the Word," features a diverse group of people in various situations who utilize the Mercedes-Benz voice-activated assistant to perform tasks such as adjusting temperature, navigating to locations, and making calls.  The ad showcases the ease and convenience of the technology, highlighting its seamless integration into daily life.  The overall tone is sleek, modern, and subtly emphasizes luxury. The scenes quickly shift, offering glimpses into diverse lifestyles.

title: Bad Passengers with Christina Applegate
original_title: 2019 M&M’s – Bad Passengers with Christina Applegate
description: The 2019 M&M's Super Bowl commercial, "Bad Passengers," features Christina Applegate as a perpetually annoyed passenger on a long bus ride.  Her fellow passengers, personified M&M's candies, are disruptive and messy, creating chaos with their candy-related antics. Applegate's exasperated reactions to their behavior provide the humor.  The ad highlights the playful, sometimes chaotic, nature of sharing M&M's and subtly positions the candy as a source of shared experiences (even if slightly irritating ones).

title: Top Dog
description: The 2019 Avocados from Mexico Super Bowl ad, "Top Dog," features a comedic showdown between a pampered chihuahua and a surprisingly agile pug. The chihuahua, representing the avocado, initially enjoys a luxurious lifestyle, symbolized by its lavish surroundings.  However, the pug, determined to become 'top dog,' challenges the chihuahua's status. The humorous competition culminates in the pug surprisingly outmaneuvering the chihuahua, ultimately securing the 'top dog' title and subtly highlighting the versatility and superior quality of avocados.

title: Not Everything Makes the Cut
original_title: 2019 AMAZON – Not Everything Makes the Cut
description: The 2019 Amazon Super Bowl ad, "Not Everything Makes the Cut," showcases a montage of humorous and quirky rejected Amazon product ideas.  It features a range of absurd inventions, from a self-folding laundry system to a pizza-delivering drone, highlighting the rigorous selection process Amazon undergoes.  The ad emphasizes the company's vast scope and its commitment to innovation by showing the sheer volume of ideas considered and ultimately discarded.

title: The Elevator with Jason Bateman
original_title: 2019 HYUNDAI Shopper Assurance – The Elevator with Jason Bateman

Through a series of increasingly absurd situations, Carell's mood improves with each Pepsi, culminating in a dance-off with Lil Jon. The ad emphasizes the simple pleasure and uplifting effect of enjoying a Pepsi.

A man orders a Michelob Ultra, and the robot flawlessly prepares and serves it.  The ad contrasts this sterile, robotic world with the simple pleasure of enjoying a refreshing beer. There is no dialogue or narrative, focusing solely on the visual appeal of the food.

title: What If?

It follows a young man who imagines alternative life paths, each showcasing a different Kia vehicle in various settings. description: The 2019 Budweiser Super Bowl ad, "Wind Never Felt Better," features Clydesdale horses frolicking in a field, showcasing their majestic nature and the brand's association with freedom and open spaces. title: Anti-Manifesto
description: The 2018 Jeep Super Bowl ad, "Anti-Manifesto," eschews a traditional product-focused approach. The visuals are stunning, featuring breathtaking scenery and various Jeep models traversing diverse terrains.  Minimal dialogue is used; the focus is on the visual experience and evocative music.  The ad promotes a lifestyle associated with Jeep ownership rather than specific vehicle features.

It showcases a variety of players from different teams performing unique and energetic celebrations, highlighting the skill, athleticism, and personality of the players.  The video is fast-paced and uses dynamic editing techniques to create a sense of energy and excitement around the NFL.

The driver, seemingly unfazed, navigates various terrains, including a muddy river and rocky hills.  The ad emphasizes the Jeep's ruggedness and capability to handle extreme conditions. The overall tone is adventurous and exciting, showcasing the vehicle's off-road prowess in a fantastical setting.

From a young girl riding a bike to a family on a cross-country trip, the ad emphasizes the adventurous spirit and freedom associated with Jeep vehicles.  The visuals are scenic and uplifting, focusing on the experiences made possible by Jeep's off-road capabilities.  Minimal dialogue is used, relying heavily on evocative imagery and music to convey the message of exploration and personal journeys.

It features Tom Cruise performing death-defying stunts, including a helicopter chase, a motorcycle jump, and intense hand-to-hand combat.  The fast-paced editing and thrilling visuals highlight the high-stakes nature of the movie, emphasizing the danger and suspense. The ad ends with the release date and the Paramount Pictures logo.

The ad concludes with the E*TRADE logo and tagline, suggesting the simplicity of their financial services compared to the complexities of life. The humor lies in the unexpected contrast between the baby's blunt honesty and the adult situations.

The ad utilizes the Star Wars theme music and establishes the film's core characters and themes of rebellion and adventure.

The ad contrasts these everyday sources of hope with grander events, subtly highlighting Hyundai's role in providing reliable transportation that facilitates hopeful journeys. The overall tone is heartwarming and optimistic, focusing on the everyday joys and connections that fuel hope.

title: The Thing Under the Bed
original_title: 2018 TURBOTAX – The Thing Under the Bed

The ad uses suspenseful music and dark lighting to build anticipation, culminating in a humorous reveal and a positive message about TurboTax simplifying tax preparation. The man's relief is palpable as he triumphantly holds a neatly organized tax document.

title: It’s a Tide Ad
description: The 2018 Tide Super Bowl commercial is a meta-ad showcasing various celebrities carrying Tide-branded items, mistaking them for their own belongings. The humor stems from the absurdity of the situation and the surprised reactions of the celebrities.  The ad cleverly uses the unexpected to highlight the Tide brand and its prevalence in many different situations.

title: Annihilation Evolution
description: The Paramount Pictures Super Bowl LII advertisement, "Annihilation Evolution," is a fast-paced montage of scenes from their upcoming movie releases in 2018.  It features quick cuts showcasing action, suspense, and fantastical elements from various films.  The trailer doesn't focus on a single movie but rather builds anticipation for Paramount's overall slate of films that year. The overall tone is exciting and visually driven, aiming to generate hype for the studio's upcoming releases.

title: One Team
description: The 2018 Toyota Super Bowl ad, "One Team," showcases a diverse group of people—athletes, musicians, and everyday individuals—collaborating on a shared project.  The ad emphasizes teamwork and unity, highlighting the collective effort required to achieve a common goal. It doesn't focus on a specific car model but rather on the brand's values.  The video uses fast cuts and upbeat music to create a dynamic and inspiring atmosphere, culminating in the unveiling of a large collaborative art piece.

title: M&M’S Again

The ad uses slapstick humor and quick cuts to showcase the playful nature of the candies, culminating in a shot of the M&M's candies scattered across a table.

title: Good Odds

The ad uses slow-motion shots to emphasize the intensity and beauty of her snowboarding runs. The focus is not on the car itself, but rather on the empowering message of overcoming challenges and achieving your goals, with a Toyota subtly placed as part of her journey. The ad concludes with a triumphant moment, and the Toyota logo appears prominently.

title: Generations This is the Pepsi

The ad emphasizes unity and shared experiences across generations, using upbeat music and quick cuts to create a dynamic and energetic feel.

The ad features humorous, fantasy elements, a medieval setting and boasts lighthearted and comedic action.

He eventually finds a vibrant, bustling city, his renewed energy symbolized by a shiny new Kia car.  The ad emphasizes feeling alive and experiencing joy through the simple act of driving a Kia, focusing on the emotional connection to the brand, rather than the car's technical aspects.

title: #GuacWorld

It showcases various scenarios where guacamole is central, from a futuristic city with guacamole-based transportation to a medieval-style feast featuring guacamole.  The ad uses quick cuts and surreal imagery to create a humorous and engaging experience, emphasizing the deliciousness and versatility of avocados.  The overall tone is lighthearted and fun, associating the product with a sense of adventure and playful excess.

title: Alexa Loses Her Voice

When Alexa loses her voice, chaos ensues as the family struggles to perform simple tasks without her assistance.  The ad humorously highlights Alexa's integration into modern life and the ensuing inconvenience when that integration is disrupted.  It ends with a shot of a very quiet and serene house.

title: Tom Clancy’s Jack Ryan

John Krasinski, as Jack Ryan, is shown in various perilous situations, including a helicopter crash and close-quarters combat.  The ad emphasizes the high-stakes thriller aspect of the series, highlighting its suspenseful plot and thrilling action.  Quick cuts and dramatic music build excitement, culminating in a call to action to watch the show on Prime Video.

title: Surprise
