Throughout the chaos, the man maintains a calm demeanor, ultimately leading to a heartwarming and successful proposal.  The ad emphasizes the unexpected nature of life and positions Yellow Tail wine as a lighthearted and enjoyable companion.

title: Peyton Manning: Vacation Quarterback
original_title: 2018 UNIVERSAL ORLANDO – Peyton Manning: Vacation Quarterback
description: The ad features Peyton Manning enjoying a vacation at Universal Orlando Resort.  It playfully contrasts his intense football persona with his relaxed vacation demeanor.  He's shown riding rides, enjoying the parks, and interacting with various Universal characters.  The overall message is that Universal Orlando is a fun and exciting vacation destination, even for a football superstar like Manning.  The humor lies in the juxtaposition of Manning's serious public image with his goofy, carefree vacation antics.

title: Human featuring Danny DeVito
description: The 2018 M&M's Super Bowl ad, "Human," features Danny DeVito as an M&M's candy.  The ad opens with DeVito's M&M character waking up in a candy factory. He then goes on a whimsical adventure, navigating the factory's machinery and ultimately finding his place among other M&M's candies.  The humor comes from the juxtaposition of DeVito's gruff personality with the cute, candy-like setting. The ad ends with a shot of the M&M's candies, implying that DeVito is now one of them.

title: Life is Short, Have a Diet Coke
original_title: 2018 DIET COKE – Life is Short, Have a Diet Coke
description: The 2018 Diet Coke Super Bowl ad features a montage of short, quirky vignettes showcasing various people enjoying Diet Coke in diverse settings.  The scenes are fast-paced and visually stimulating, highlighting the drink's refreshing quality and its association with moments of joy and spontaneity.  There's no overarching narrative; instead, the ad relies on a series of quick cuts and humorous situations to create a sense of upbeat energy and emphasize the simple pleasure of drinking a Diet Coke.

title: Stand By You
description: The 2018 Budweiser Super Bowl ad, "Stand By You," depicts a heartwarming journey through American history, showcasing Budweiser's presence at pivotal moments.  It uses archival footage intercut with modern-day scenes, highlighting themes of resilience and companionship. The ad emphasizes the brand's long-standing connection with American culture and its role in shared experiences, culminating in a message of unity and support.

title: My Bleep Don’t Stink
description: The 2018 Febreze Super Bowl commercial, "My Bleep Don't Stink," features a diverse group of people in various scenarios dealing with unpleasant odors.  A woman confidently uses Febreze to eliminate lingering smells from her car, a man tackles a musty gym bag, and a family tackles a variety of pungent household situations. The ad emphasizes Febreze's ability to effectively neutralize odors, showcasing its versatility and efficacy in diverse settings,  with a lighthearted and humorous tone throughout.

title: Featuring Marvel’s Black Panther
original_title: 2018 LEXUS LS 500 – Featuring Marvel’s Black Panther
description: The 2018 Lexus LS 500 Super Bowl ad features Chadwick Boseman as Black Panther.  The ad opens with him driving the Lexus through a futuristic city, emphasizing the car's sleek design and advanced technology.  The visuals are stylish and cinematic, showcasing the car's performance capabilities in a sleek, controlled manner.  There is minimal dialogue, allowing the visuals and the presence of Black Panther to tell the story of the luxury vehicle.

title: Who Wouldn’t
description: The 2018 Groupon Super Bowl commercial showcases a diverse range of people enjoying various Groupon deals.  Scenes quickly cut between individuals participating in activities like zip-lining, attending a concert, getting massages, and enjoying fine dining, all highlighted as being significantly discounted through Groupon. The ad emphasizes the wide variety of experiences available at affordable prices, implying that 'who wouldn't' want to take advantage of such deals. The overall tone is upbeat and comedic, showcasing the sheer variety of experiences offered by Groupon.

title: Epic College Stories
description: The Natural Light Super Bowl LII commercial, "Epic College Stories," uses humorous, exaggerated vignettes to depict relatable and absurd college experiences.  Scenes include a student attempting to sneak a Natty Light into a lecture hall, a keg stand gone wrong, and a wild dorm party. The overall tone is lighthearted and nostalgic, focusing on the shared experiences and camaraderie of college life, associating the beer with those memories.

title: Ye Olde Pep Talk
original_title: 2018 BUD LIGHT – Ye Olde Pep Talk
description: The 2018 Bud Light Super Bowl ad, "Ye Olde Pep Talk," features a medieval-themed setting where a king (played by comedian Paul Lieberstein) gives a rousing pep talk to his knights before a joust.  The knights are surprisingly inept, and the humor lies in their clumsy attempts at chivalry and the king's increasingly desperate attempts to motivate them.  The ad concludes with the king raising a Bud Light, suggesting the beer is the ultimate source of inspiration (or at least a good way to cope with impending defeat).

title: Taps
description: The Stella Artois Super Bowl LII commercial, "Taps," highlights the global water crisis.  It features Matt Damon, the brand's water advocacy partner, narrating the story of a young girl's daily arduous journey to collect water.  The ad contrasts this with the ease of access to clean water in developed countries.  It concludes with a call to action, encouraging viewers to donate to WATER.org, to help provide clean water to communities in need.

brand: 20TH CENTURY FOX LI TV COMMERCIAL “A CURE FOR WELLNESS
title: Take The Cure”
original_title: 2017 20th Century Fox Super Bowl 51 (LI) TV Commercial “A Cure For Wellness – Take The Cure”
description: The Super Bowl LI commercial for 'A Cure for Wellness' presents a disturbingly beautiful spa.  Locke (Dane DeHaan) arrives to retrieve his CEO, only to find himself trapped and subjected to unsettling treatments.  The ad showcases eerie imagery—a decaying spa, unsettling rituals, and unnerving close-ups—building suspense and mystery around the film's premise of a wellness center with sinister secrets.  It ends with a chilling voiceover and the movie's title card, generating intrigue rather than revealing the plot.

brand: COMEDY CENTRAL LI TV COMMERCIAL “HELLO DETROIT
title: Detroiters”
original_title: 2017 Comedy Central Super Bowl 51 (LI) TV Commercial “Hello, Detroit – Detroiters”
description: The Comedy Central Super Bowl LI ad features a comedic montage showcasing the Detroiters TV show.  Quick cuts highlight various scenes from the show, emphasizing its quirky humor and characters. The overall message is promotional, aiming to attract viewers to the show.  It uses fast-paced editing and relies heavily on the visual humor already present in the show's content rather than creating a new narrative specifically for the advertisement.

title: Grace”
original_title: 2017 20th Century Fox Super Bowl 51 (LI) TV Commercial “Logan – Grace”
description: The Super Bowl LI commercial for the film 'Logan' showcases a tender moment between the aging Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) and a young girl named Laura (Dafne Keen).  The ad emphasizes their close bond through a montage of quiet, intimate scenes interspersed with brief glimpses of action-packed sequences. It highlights the film's themes of family, sacrifice, and unexpected tenderness, contrasting Wolverine's gruff exterior with his protective nature toward Laura.  The overall tone is emotional and sets a serious, mature tone different from typical superhero fare.

title: Ad  ‘Easy Driver’ Directed by Coen Brothers
original_title: Mercedes-Benz 2017 Super Bowl Ad  ‘Easy Driver’ Directed by Coen Brothers
description: The Mercedes-Benz Super Bowl LII commercial, directed by the Coen Brothers, features a man driving a sleek Mercedes-Benz through various surreal and humorous scenarios.  He effortlessly navigates a chaotic, almost comedically absurd world, facing bizarre challenges like a giant, rolling boulder and a rapidly changing landscape. The ad showcases the car's smooth handling and luxurious features indirectly, focusing more on the comedic and absurd visuals rather than explicitly highlighting specific car features.

title: The Secret Life Of Pets
original_title: 2016 UNIVERSAL PICTURES – The Secret Life Of Pets
description: The Super Bowl ad for Universal Pictures' "The Secret Life of Pets" showcases a montage of quick, funny scenes from the animated film.  It highlights the pets' mischievous and adventurous activities while their owners are away.  The ad uses upbeat music and fast cuts to create a sense of excitement and humor, emphasizing the film's comedic nature and appealing to a broad audience.  The ad doesn't focus on any particular plot points but effectively generates interest in the movie.

title: Every Drop Counts
description: The 2016 Colgate "Every Drop Counts" Super Bowl commercial showcases the importance of water conservation.  It opens with a vibrant, bustling city scene then transitions to show the impact of even small amounts of water, highlighting its preciousness.  The ad emphasizes the small changes individuals can make to save water, subtly incorporating Colgate's role in encouraging mindful water usage through its products.  The overall tone is positive and encouraging, aiming to inspire viewers to adopt water-saving habits.

title: Zeke
description: The Dollar Shave Club Super Bowl 2016 ad, "Zeke," features a man named Zeke showcasing the company's products.  He enthusiastically demonstrates the razors, highlighting their quality and affordability.  The ad uses quirky humor, showing Zeke in various situations using the razors, emphasizing their effectiveness and convenience. It's a fast-paced, comedic portrayal of everyday shaving experiences, concluding with a call to action to subscribe.

title: Simply Put.
description: The Budweiser 2016 Super Bowl commercial, "Simply Put," tells the story of Budweiser's history from its humble beginnings in 1876 to its current status as a global brand.  The ad uses a montage of historical images and footage interwoven with scenes of the brewing process and modern-day celebrations, showcasing the brand's longevity and cultural impact.  It emphasizes the simple ingredients and the dedication to quality that have defined Budweiser throughout its history. The narrative is largely visual, with minimal dialogue.

title: Robot Razors
description: The 2016 Schick Hydro Super Bowl commercial features a futuristic setting where robots are meticulously shaving with Schick Hydro razors.  The robots demonstrate the razor's smoothness and precision in a series of close-up shots, highlighting the ease and comfort of the shaving experience. The ad emphasizes the razor's technology and its ability to provide a close, comfortable shave, even for robots.  The overall tone is humorous, with the unexpected use of robots creating a comedic contrast.

title: Restricted Bling
description: The 2016 T-Mobile Super Bowl commercial, "Restricted Bling," features Drake as a fictionalized, overly cautious version of himself.  He meticulously guards his phone, paranoid about data overages.  The humor comes from the extreme measures he takes to avoid going over his data limit, showcasing a contrast between his celebrity status and his frugal data usage habits. The ad concludes with a T-Mobile data plan benefit.

title: Walken Closet
description: The Kia Optima Super Bowl 2016 commercial, "Walken Closet," features Christopher Walken in a comedic role.  He's seen in a dimly lit closet, showcasing the car's features in an exaggerated and quirky manner.  Walken's unique delivery and deadpan humor are used to highlight the Optima's spaciousness and storage. The ad concludes with a shot of the car driving off, reinforced by Walken's voiceover.

title: 4x4ever
description: The 2016 Jeep Super Bowl commercial, "4x4ever," showcases the Jeep Wrangler's off-road capabilities through a montage of diverse individuals and settings.  It features various people enjoying adventurous activities in their Jeeps, from traversing rugged terrains to exploring scenic landscapes. The ad emphasizes the Jeep's durability and versatility, highlighting its suitability for a wide range of lifestyles and adventures.  The overall tone is uplifting and aspirational, associating the Jeep brand with freedom, exploration, and a connection to nature.

title: Find Your Magic
description: The 2016 AXE "Find Your Magic" Super Bowl commercial showcases diverse individuals discovering their unique talents and passions.  It features a montage of people engaging in various activities, from skateboarding and parkour to musical performances and artistic creations. The ad emphasizes self-discovery, individuality, and embracing one's unique abilities.  It uses upbeat music and quick cuts to convey a sense of energy and excitement, subtly linking these diverse activities to the AXE brand.

title: Every Series. Entire Seasons. Now Streaming
original_title: 2016 SHOWTIME – Every Series. Entire Seasons. Now Streaming
description: The 2016 Showtime Super Bowl ad rapidly cuts through scenes from various Showtime series, highlighting their diverse genres and dramatic moments.  The fast-paced montage emphasizes the breadth of content available on the streaming service.  The overall message is that Showtime offers a wide variety of complete series, all available for streaming.  There's no central narrative or specific storyline; instead, it's a showcase of compelling visuals and dramatic tension from different shows.

title: Jungle Book
description: The 2016 Disney Super Bowl ad for "The Jungle Book" is a visually stunning montage of scenes from the movie.  It showcases Mowgli's adventures in the jungle, highlighting the realistic CGI animals and action sequences.  The trailer emphasizes the film's exciting plot, featuring iconic characters like Baloo and Bagheera, and the thrilling escape from Shere Khan.  The ad uses a dramatic musical score to build anticipation for the film's release.

title: Dualities
description: The Fitbit 2016 Super Bowl commercial, "Dualities," uses split-screen imagery to juxtapose contrasting lifestyles and activities.  It showcases diverse individuals—from athletes to artists—using Fitbits to track their fitness journeys.  The ad emphasizes the duality of rest and activity, work and play, and highlights the versatility of the Fitbit in various contexts.  The overall message promotes a healthy and balanced lifestyle achievable with the help of the Fitbit tracker.

title: Not Backing Down
description: The 2016 Budweiser Super Bowl ad, "Not Backing Down," depicts a Clydesdale foal's journey from birth to adulthood, intercut with scenes of a farmer raising him.  It highlights the resilience and determination of both the horse and the farmer, mirroring Budweiser's own history and perseverance. The ad emphasizes the brand's connection to tradition and the American spirit, culminating in the foal proudly joining the Clydesdale team.

title: A New Truck to Love
original_title: 2016 HONDA – A New Truck to Love
description: The 2016 Honda Ridgeline commercial showcases the truck's versatility and capability through a series of vignettes.  It highlights its unique features, such as the in-bed trunk, while depicting various scenarios: a couple enjoying a tailgate party, a family going on an adventure, and a contractor using it for work.  The overall message emphasizes the truck's adaptability to different lifestyles and its ability to enhance everyday experiences.  The ad uses upbeat music and quick cuts to maintain a positive and energetic tone.

title: Wiener Stampede
description: The Heinz ketchup Super Bowl 2016 commercial, "Wiener Stampede," depicts a herd of cartoonish wiener dogs chaotically running towards a massive ketchup bottle.  The dogs are anthropomorphic, wearing hats and clothes, and their stampede is comically frantic.  The ad culminates with the dogs enthusiastically diving into the ketchup bottle, emphasizing Heinz ketchup's appeal and creating a humorous, memorable image.

title: Start Stunning
description: The 2016 Wix.com Super Bowl ad, "Start Stunning," showcases a montage of diverse individuals and businesses using Wix to create visually impressive websites.  It emphasizes the ease and accessibility of Wix's website builder, highlighting its user-friendly interface and the potential for anyone to build a professional-looking online presence. The ad features quick cuts of various website designs, interspersed with shots of satisfied users and upbeat music. The overall message is that Wix empowers individuals and businesses to create stunning websites easily.

title: Bolder Than Bold Jump
description: The 2016 Butterfinger Super Bowl commercial, "Bolder Than Bold Jump," features a man attempting increasingly daring and ridiculous stunts to avoid sharing his Butterfinger candy bar.  He performs a series of increasingly improbable jumps and maneuvers, culminating in a final, gravity-defying leap. The humor derives from the absurdity of his actions and his determination to keep the candy bar all to himself. The commercial emphasizes the candy bar's deliciousness and the lengths people might go to keep it for themselves.

title: X-Men: Apocalypse
description: The Super Bowl ad for X-Men: Apocalypse showcases intense action sequences featuring the X-Men battling Apocalypse.  Quick cuts display the mutant powers and the apocalyptic setting.  It highlights the film's high-stakes conflict and visual spectacle, aiming to generate excitement and anticipation for the movie's release.  The ad features little dialogue, relying primarily on visuals to convey the story and establish the film's tone.

title: Death Wish Coffee-Storm’s a-Brewin’
description: The 2016 Intuit Super Bowl ad, titled "Death Wish Coffee - Storm's a-Brewin'," features a comedic depiction of a chaotic office scene. Employees are overwhelmed and stressed, struggling to manage their finances.  The ad highlights the struggles of small business owners and the chaos associated with running a business, before showcasing Intuit's software as a solution to streamline operations and reduce stress. The ad uses humor and fast-paced visuals to convey its message.

title: Man From The Future
description: A time traveler from the future arrives in the present, marveling at the advanced technology of LG's OLED TV's picture quality.  He's initially awestruck by the vibrant colors and clarity, and then uses the TV to communicate with his future self, showcasing the smart features. The commercial emphasizes the superior image quality and technological advancement of the LG OLED TV, contrasting the past with the present.

title: Never a Sellout
description: The TurboTax 2016 Super Bowl commercial, "Never a Sellout," features a diverse group of people from various walks of life expressing their individuality and refusing to conform to societal pressures.  The ad utilizes quick cuts and energetic music to showcase people pursuing unconventional careers and hobbies. It highlights the idea of pursuing personal passions rather than conforming to expectations and implicitly connects this to TurboTax's ability to help individuals take control of their finances and life choices. The commercial concludes with the TurboTax logo and tagline.

title: ENVY
description: The 2016 AstraZeneca Super Bowl ad, "ENVY," depicts a series of everyday scenarios where people experience feelings of envy.  It shows various individuals reacting to others' seemingly better situations—a man coveting a neighbor's fancy car, a woman admiring another's stylish outfit, etc.  The ad subtly highlights that these feelings are common, emphasizing the differences in individual lives and experiences. The commercial concludes with a website address, promoting AstraZeneca's OICisDifferent.com, presumably a platform for a health initiative related to these emotional differences.

title: I Can Do That
description: The 2016 Pokémon Super Bowl ad, "I Can Do That," showcases children engaging in imaginative play using Pokémon cards and toys.  The ad emphasizes the fun and engaging aspects of Pokémon, showing kids using their imaginations to create scenarios with their Pokémon.  Quick cuts between various scenes of children playing highlight the diverse ways children interact with the Pokémon franchise.  The ad concludes with a shot of various Pokémon characters.

title: Defy Labels
description: The 2016 MINI Super Bowl commercial, "Defy Labels," showcases a diverse group of individuals rejecting societal expectations.  The ad uses quick cuts and vibrant visuals, highlighting various lifestyles and personalities – a musician, a chef, a skateboarder, among others –  all driving MINIs.  It emphasizes individuality and self-expression, suggesting that MINI cars are for those who don't conform to stereotypes. The overall tone is upbeat and energetic, focusing on the freedom and flexibility associated with the MINI brand.

title: Doritos Dogs
description: The 2016 Doritos Super Bowl commercial, "Doritos Dogs," features a comedic chase scene.  A man dressed as a hot dog runs from a group of people desperately chasing him.  He uses his hot dog costume and agility to cleverly evade capture.  The chase involves various humorous obstacles and culminates in a surprising and funny ending.  The connection to Doritos is subtle, primarily through branding at the beginning and end.

title: Text Talk
description: The 2016 NO MORE Super Bowl ad, "Text Talk," depicts a series of text message exchanges between a young couple.  The texts start playfully but escalate to disturbing levels, subtly hinting at domestic violence. The ad ends with a stark message and helpline number for the NO MORE campaign against domestic violence.  The visuals are simple, focusing on the text messages and their escalating emotional tone to convey the seriousness of the issue.

title: Baldwin Bowl Party
description: The 2016 Amazon Echo Super Bowl ad, "Baldwin Bowl Party," features Stephen Baldwin hosting a Super Bowl party where he uses an Amazon Echo to control various aspects of the party, such as playing music, ordering pizza, and setting the mood lighting.  The humorous ad highlights the Echo's voice-activated capabilities and ease of use in a fun, relatable party setting.  Baldwin's comedic performance underscores the convenience and entertainment value offered by the smart home device.

title: Joy of Pepsi
description: The 2016 Pepsi Super Bowl ad, "Joy of Pepsi," features various people enjoying Pepsi in diverse settings.  It showcases a vibrant, upbeat atmosphere with quick cuts between scenes of people dancing, laughing, and generally having a good time while consuming Pepsi.  The ad emphasizes the feeling of joy and togetherness associated with the drink, using catchy music and energetic visuals to create a positive and exciting mood. There is no overarching narrative or plot; the focus is purely on the product and the positive emotions it supposedly evokes.

title: Unfiltered Talk
description: The Shock Top Unfiltered Talk Super Bowl ad features a group of friends enjoying Shock Top beer while engaging in candid, sometimes awkward, conversations.  The humor lies in the relatable and slightly uncomfortable nature of their honest discussions.  Various scenes depict the friends laughing and interacting in a casual setting, highlighting the beer as a catalyst for unfiltered communication. The overall tone is lighthearted and emphasizes the idea that Shock Top is a beer best shared with friends.

title: The Longest Chase
description: A young boy, seemingly possessed by an unrelenting spirit of play, leads a relentless chase through various terrains, evading capture despite the best efforts of his pursuers.  The chase scenes are interspersed with shots showcasing the Toyota Prius's smooth operation and fuel efficiency. The advertisement concludes with the boy finally outrunning his pursuers, emphasizing the Prius's ability to go the distance.  The overall tone is lighthearted, emphasizing the car's endurance and capabilities in an entertaining fashion.

title: Independence Day: Resurgence
description: The Super Bowl ad for Independence Day: Resurgence uses quick cuts of intense action sequences from the movie.  We see scenes of alien spacecraft, explosions, and military combat.  The trailer emphasizes the scale of the alien invasion and the heroic efforts to fight back. It's a high-energy, visually spectacular preview designed to generate excitement for the film's release. The overall tone is action-packed and suspenseful, offering a glimpse into the thrilling plot.

title: Resources
description: The 2016 WeatherTech Super Bowl ad showcases the brand's commitment to American manufacturing and its high-quality car floor mats.  The ad features shots of the WeatherTech factory, highlighting the production process and the dedication of its employees.  It emphasizes the durability and precision of their products, using slow-motion shots to display the details of the manufacturing process and the final product. The overall tone is one of pride in American craftsmanship and the superior quality of WeatherTech's goods.

title: Hulk vs. Ant-Man
description: The Coca-Cola Mini Super Bowl 2016 ad depicts a humorous battle between the Hulk and Ant-Man over a Coca-Cola Mini.  Ant-Man, incredibly tiny, uses his size to his advantage, initially overwhelming the Hulk.  The Hulk, however, eventually gains the upper hand, only to be outsmarted by Ant-Man's clever tactics. The ad concludes with a playful, unexpected twist, leaving the viewer uncertain about who truly won. The focus is on the small size of the Coca-Cola Mini can.

title: America’s #1 Rated
description: The 2016 Persil ProClean Super Bowl ad showcases the detergent's cleaning power through a series of quick cuts depicting various tough stains being effortlessly removed from clothing.  The visuals are fast-paced and dynamic, emphasizing the product's effectiveness.  The ad uses upbeat music and quick transitions to highlight the product's benefit of stain removal. There is no narrative or storyline beyond demonstrating the product's efficacy.

title: Drop The Balls
description: The 2016 T-Mobile Super Bowl commercial, "Drop the Balls," features Drake and the band, the Lonely Island, alongside a variety of celebrities.  The ad uses humor to promote T-Mobile's unlimited data plan. It showcases the frustration of slow data speeds, portraying people dropping various objects in increasingly absurd scenarios due to dropped calls or slow loading. The humorous situations highlight the contrast between the inconvenience of insufficient data and the seamless connectivity offered by T-Mobile.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
original_title: 2016 PARAMOUNT PICTURES – Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
description: The Super Bowl ad for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows showcases action-packed scenes from the movie.  We see the Turtles fighting Shredder and his Foot Clan, utilizing their ninja skills and weaponry.  Quick cuts highlight the Turtles' personalities and their humorous interactions.  The ad emphasizes the film's action and comedic elements, creating excitement for the movie's release.

title: Ryanville
description: The Hyundai Ryanville Super Bowl ad features actor Ryan Reynolds as the mayor of a town entirely sponsored by Hyundai.  Reynolds showcases various Hyundai models, highlighting their features in humorous ways. The ad uses quirky humor and situations, like a town-wide dance party, to promote the vehicles.  The overall message emphasizes the value and fun associated with Hyundai cars.

title: The Portrait
description: The 2016 Skittles Super Bowl commercial, "The Portrait," depicts a man meticulously painting a portrait of a bowl of Skittles.  The process is oddly detailed and time-consuming. The artist's intense focus on the candy is humorous, culminating in a final, dramatic reveal of the completed artwork. The ad uses quirky visuals and minimal dialogue to highlight the unique and colorful nature of Skittles.

title: The Bud Light Party
original_title: 2016 BUD LIGHT – The Bud Light Party
description: The 2016 Bud Light Super Bowl commercial, "The Bud Light Party," features a seemingly endless party scene with various people enjoying Bud Light in different settings.  The ad uses rapid cuts and a montage style to showcase the fun and social aspects of consuming the beer.  Celebrities like Amy Schumer and Paul Rudd make brief appearances, enhancing the festive atmosphere. The overall tone is lighthearted and celebratory, associating Bud Light with good times and camaraderie.

title: First look
original_title: 2016 UNIVERSAL PICTURES – Jason Borne – First look
description: The Super Bowl ad is a short, action-packed teaser for the Jason Bourne film. It features quick cuts of intense fight scenes, chases, and glimpses of Bourne (Matt Damon) in various locations.  The tone is dark and suspenseful, highlighting the film's action elements.  Minimal dialogue is used; the focus is on visual thrills and a sense of mystery surrounding Bourne's return.

title: What We Were Thinking
original_title: 2016 QUICKEN LOANS – What We Were Thinking
description: The Quicken Loans 2016 Super Bowl ad, "What We Were Thinking," features employees of the company sharing their initial reactions and doubts about the ambitious Rocket Mortgage campaign.  The ad uses a humorous, self-deprecating tone, showcasing candid footage and contrasting it with the eventual success of the campaign. It highlights the initial skepticism and nervousness surrounding the launch, before transitioning to scenes of celebration following its positive reception.  The ad emphasizes the human element of the company and the risk-taking involved in innovation.

title: What He Said
description: The 2016 Acura NSX Super Bowl commercial, "What He Said," features a man driving the new NSX on a winding mountain road.  He's impressed by the car's performance, commenting on its features. The ad focuses on showcasing the car's sleek design, speed, and handling, emphasizing its technological advancements.  The driver's enthusiastic reactions highlight the driving experience.  The commercial ends with the Acura NSX logo and tagline.

title: Cascada Convertible
description: The 2016 Buick Cascada convertible ad showcases the car's sleek design and features.  It opens with a woman driving the Cascada along a scenic coastal highway.  The camera focuses on the car's convertible top, its interior, and its smooth ride. The visuals emphasize luxury, style, and the feeling of freedom associated with open-air driving.  The ad concludes with a shot of the car parked overlooking the ocean, highlighting its sophisticated aesthetic.

title: Distant Memory
description: The Advil 'Distant Memory' Super Bowl ad depicts a series of seemingly mundane, everyday scenarios (a child's birthday party, a family gathering) that are subtly disrupted by minor aches and pains.  These inconveniences are quickly resolved with Advil, leaving the viewer with the impression of seamless, pain-free moments. The overall tone is light and positive, focusing on the relief Advil provides and allowing happy memories to unfold without interruption.

title: Bigger Than…
description: The 2016 Taco Bell Super Bowl ad, "Bigger Than…," uses comedic exaggeration to showcase the brand's relevance.  It begins with a seemingly serious narrator discussing significant historical events, juxtaposing them with increasingly absurd claims about Taco Bell's impact.  The humor lies in the outlandish comparisons, such as equating Taco Bell's influence to the invention of the wheel or the moon landing. The ad concludes with a final, comical assertion about Taco Bell's importance, emphasizing its pervasive presence and popularity.

title: Real Talk with Key and Peele
original_title: 2016 SQUARESPACE – Real Talk with Key and Peele
description: Key and Peele, playing exaggerated versions of themselves, discuss the challenges of creating a website.  Peele emphasizes the difficulty of designing a site from scratch, while Key highlights the simplicity and ease of use offered by Squarespace. The ad uses humor to showcase Squarespace's user-friendliness, culminating in a visually appealing website created effortlessly by Key.  The overall message promotes Squarespace as an easy-to-use website building platform.

title: Love the Outside
description: The Marmot Super Bowl 2016 ad showcases diverse individuals enjoying various outdoor activities.  It features quick cuts of people hiking, climbing, camping, kayaking, and snowboarding in stunning natural settings. The overall message promotes the joy and freedom found in experiencing nature, emphasizing the durability and functionality of Marmot gear implicitly through showcasing people actively using their products in demanding environments.  There's no voiceover or narrative, focusing solely on the visuals of outdoor adventure.

title: Boston Tea Party
description: The TurboTax 2015 Super Bowl commercial, titled "Boston Tea Party," humorously reimagines the historical event.  It depicts colonists dressed in period clothing using modern technology, specifically TurboTax, to easily file their taxes.  The scene quickly transitions from the struggle of manual tax preparation to the ease and speed of using TurboTax, culminating in a triumphant tea party celebration, suggesting a stress-free tax season.  The ad emphasizes the simplicity and efficiency of the software.

title: Super Apology
description: The 2015 Sprint Super Bowl ad, "Super Apology," features a series of humorous vignettes showing people apologizing for various minor inconveniences.  These range from a slow-motion apology for accidentally bumping into someone to a grand, over-the-top apology for a spilled drink.  The common thread is the exaggerated reactions and the overall comedic tone, culminating in a message highlighting Sprint's network reliability as a solution to avoiding such apologetic situations.

title: America Start Your Engines with Nick Offerman
original_title: 2015 NBC Sports – America Start Your Engines with Nick Offerman
description: Nick Offerman, playing a rugged outdoorsman, enthusiastically promotes NBC Sports' coverage of various sporting events.  The ad features quick cuts of exciting sporting moments interspersed with Offerman's charismatic delivery of lines like "America, start your engines!"  It emphasizes the thrill and excitement of the upcoming sports season, showcasing a variety of sports like NASCAR, Olympics and football, highlighting NBC's comprehensive coverage. The overall tone is energetic and humorous, relying on Offerman's personality to sell the network's programming.

title: Heroes Reborn: The Aurora
description: The 2015 Super Bowl ad for NBC's Heroes Reborn showcases a montage of quick, action-packed scenes featuring the returning characters from the original Heroes series.  It highlights their powers and hints at the upcoming storyline, emphasizing mystery and suspense.  The visuals are dark and dramatic, with a focus on special effects and intense moments.  The ad ends with the show's title and premiere date, creating anticipation for the new season.

title: Make it Happy
description: The Coca-Cola 'Make It Happy' Super Bowl ad shows a series of seemingly mundane, slightly frustrating everyday situations.  These range from a spilled drink to a missed goal.  However, with the appearance of a Coca-Cola, each situation is instantly transformed into a joyful, upbeat moment.  The ad emphasizes the power of simple happiness and uses quick cuts and a positive soundtrack to drive home its message.

title: Ted 2
description: The Super Bowl ad for Ted 2 shows comedic clips from the movie.  It features Seth MacFarlane's Ted, a foul-mouthed teddy bear, engaged in various humorous situations. title: Matthew’s Day Off
description: The 2012 Honda CRV Super Bowl ad, "Matthew's Day Off," follows a young man named Matthew as he enjoys a surprisingly adventurous day.  He uses his CRV for various activities, including wakeboarding, skateboarding, and mountain biking.  The ad emphasizes the versatility and capability of the CRV, showcasing its ability to handle diverse terrains and activities while maintaining a fun and lighthearted tone. The commercial ends with Matthew driving off in his CRV.

title: Body Paint
description: The 2012 GoDaddy Super Bowl ad features a woman getting body-painted to resemble a GoDaddy website.  The process is shown in fast-forward, with humorous commentary and suggestive imagery.  The ad concludes with the painted woman appearing on the website, showcasing the ease of website creation.  The overall tone is comedic and suggestive, relying on visual humor and a quick pace to get the message across. The focus is on the simplicity and speed of creating a website with GoDaddy.

title: Man’s Best Friend
description: A dog meticulously plans and executes a complex heist to steal a bag of Doritos from his owner.  The ad uses comedic timing and slow-motion shots to highlight the dog's cunning and determination.  The owner remains blissfully unaware until the very end, when he discovers the empty bag. The focus is on the dog's adorable persistence and the irresistible appeal of Doritos.

title: The Tease with John Stamos
original_title: 2012 DANNON OIKOS – The Tease with John Stamos
description: The 2012 Dannon Oikos Super Bowl ad, "The Tease," features John Stamos playfully interacting with a woman while subtly highlighting the yogurt's creamy texture.  The ad uses a humorous, suggestive approach, emphasizing the product's thickness and deliciousness. Stamos's charm and the playful banter between him and the woman create a lighthearted, attention-grabbing advertisement.  The focus remains on the yogurt's desirable qualities through visual and auditory cues.

title: Catch NE Bear
description: The 2012 Coca-Cola Super Bowl ad, "Catch NE Bear," features a playful chase between a young boy and a polar bear.  The boy, armed with a Coca-Cola, playfully tries to catch the bear, who is enjoying a Coke himself. The ad emphasizes the refreshing nature of Coca-Cola through the lively pursuit and the shared enjoyment of the drink between the unlikely pair.  The setting is a snowy, whimsical landscape. The chase culminates with a friendly interaction, reinforcing the brand's association with fun and happiness.

title: Arghh NY Bear
description: A Coca-Cola Super Bowl ad from 2012 featuring a grumpy bear in New York City. The bear is initially irritated by the city's hustle and bustle, but eventually warms up to it after sharing a Coca-Cola with a construction worker.  The ad emphasizes the simple pleasure and shared enjoyment of a Coca-Cola, culminating in a heartwarming moment of connection between the bear and the human.

title: Happy Grad
description: The 2012 Chevrolet Super Bowl ad, "Happy Grad," depicts a heartwarming scene of a recent college graduate receiving a new Chevrolet as a graduation gift.  The commercial emphasizes the excitement and joy of this milestone, showcasing the car as a symbol of achievement and independence. The graduate's emotional reaction and the celebratory atmosphere highlight the positive association between the vehicle and a momentous life event. The ad focuses on the feeling of accomplishment and the future possibilities implied by car ownership.

title: Return Of The King
description: The 2012 Budweiser Super Bowl commercial, "Return of the King," features a Clydesdale horse returning to the Budweiser stables after a long journey.  The ad showcases the horse's majestic presence and the bond between the animal and its handlers. It emphasizes themes of loyalty, homecoming, and the classic Budweiser brand imagery, culminating in the horse's triumphant return and a shot of the Budweiser logo.

title: Rescue Dog
description: A Bud Light Super Bowl commercial from 2012 featuring a rescue dog.  The ad opens with a montage of a dog's life in a shelter, then shows it being adopted.  The dog's new owner enjoys various activities with the dog, always including a Bud Light.  The commercial emphasizes the joy and companionship of adopting a pet, subtly connecting it to the enjoyment of Bud Light with friends. The overall tone is heartwarming and lighthearted.

title: Platinum Factory
description: The 2012 Bud Light Platinum Super Bowl commercial, "Platinum Factory," depicts a futuristic, highly automated factory meticulously crafting Bud Light Platinum beer.  The process is shown with a comedically serious tone, highlighting the precision and care (ironically) put into the brewing process. The ad emphasizes the premium nature of the beer through the exaggerated factory setting and its sleek, modern aesthetic.  It features no celebrities or overt emotional appeals, focusing solely on the product and its purported high quality.

title: Performance Basketball
description: The 2012 Bridgestone Super Bowl ad, titled "Performance Basketball," features a series of basketball trick shots performed with exceptional skill.  The shots are increasingly difficult and impressive, showcasing athleticism and precision.  The basketball itself is subtly integrated into the background, highlighting the brand's association with performance and precision, indirectly linking it to the qualities needed for a high-performance tire. The ad concludes with the Bridgestone logo.

title: Performance Football
description: The 2012 Bridgestone Super Bowl ad, "Performance Football," showcases the brand's tires through a series of dynamic football-themed scenes.  It features quick cuts of impressive athletic feats on the field, highlighting speed, agility, and control.  The visuals emphasize the tire's grip and performance capabilities, associating them with the precision and power of professional football players.  The overall message connects Bridgestone's tire performance with the high-performance nature of the sport.

title: David Beckham Bodywear
description: The 2012 H&M Super Bowl ad features David Beckham showcasing his bodywear line. The ad is sleek and minimalist, primarily showing Beckham in various shots, highlighting the clothing's fit and design.  There's minimal dialogue or action; the focus is on Beckham's physique and the understated elegance of the underwear and loungewear.  The overall tone is sophisticated and aspirational, leveraging Beckham's celebrity status to promote the product.

title: Mr. Quiggly
description: The 2012 Skechers commercial, "Mr. Quiggly," features a quirky, animated character named Mr. Quiggly who showcases the comfort and flexibility of Skechers shoes.  Mr. Quiggly performs various energetic dance moves and athletic feats in different environments, highlighting the shoe's adaptability. The ad uses vibrant colors and humorous animation to demonstrate the shoes' capabilities.

title: Eternal Optimism
description: The 2012 Budweiser Super Bowl commercial, "Eternal Optimism," showcases a Clydesdale foal's journey from birth to adulthood, interspersed with scenes of American life.  It emphasizes themes of perseverance, hope, and the passage of time, culminating in the foal's integration into the iconic Budweiser Clydesdale team.  The ad uses heartwarming visuals and a stirring musical score to create a sense of nostalgia and national pride.

title: John Carter
description: The 2012 Super Bowl ad for Disney's John Carter showcases spectacular visuals from the film.  It features sweeping shots of Martian landscapes, thrilling action sequences with John Carter battling alien creatures, and glimpses of the film's heroine.  The trailer emphasizes the film's scale, adventure, and otherworldly setting, aiming to pique viewers' interest in the science fiction epic.  The ad uses fast-paced editing and a dramatic musical score to create a sense of excitement and wonder.

title: The Avengers
description: This Super Bowl ad is a theatrical trailer for the Marvel film, 'The Avengers.' It showcases quick cuts of action sequences featuring the assembled superhero team – Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye.  The trailer highlights the film's impending release and the epic battle against Loki.  It uses dramatic music and impressive visual effects to create a sense of urgency and excitement.

title: Drive the Dream (extended version)
original_title: 2012 KIA OPTIMA – Drive the Dream (extended version)
description: The KIA Optima Super Bowl ad, "Drive the Dream," follows a young boy's journey from dreaming of playing professional basketball to achieving that dream.  The ad uses montage-style editing to show his dedication and hard work, interspersed with shots of the KIA Optima.  The car acts as a visual representation of his progress, consistently present as he practices, travels, and ultimately succeeds.  The overall message emphasizes perseverance and the pursuit of dreams.

title: It’s Reinvented
description: The 2012 Toyota Camry Super Bowl commercial showcases the redesigned car's sleek, modern look.  The ad uses quick cuts and dynamic visuals, emphasizing the vehicle's performance and stylish features. It features a diverse cast of people interacting with the Camry in various settings, highlighting its versatility and appeal to a broad audience.  The overall message is one of reinvention and modernity, signifying a departure from previous Camry models.

title: Free To Pee
description: The 2012 TAXACT Super Bowl commercial, "Free to Pee," depicts a man's desperate need to urinate during a long tax preparation process.  He endures increasingly uncomfortable situations, finally finding relief only after using TAXACT's quick and easy online tax filing service. The humor lies in the exaggerated portrayal of his bladder urgency and the contrast between his suffering and the ease of the TAXACT solution. The ad emphasizes the speed and convenience of the service.

title: Act Of Valor
description: The Relativity Media Super Bowl 2012 ad for the film "Act of Valor" features real-life Navy SEALs in intense combat situations.  The trailer showcases gripping action sequences, including close-quarters combat, explosive firefights, and stealth operations.  It highlights the bravery and skill of the SEALs while offering glimpses of the movie's plot involving dangerous missions and high stakes. The ad relies heavily on visceral action and dramatic intensity to generate interest in the film.

title: Kings Court
description: The 2012 Pepsi Super Bowl commercial, "Kings Court," features several celebrities, including  David Beckham,  Lionel Messi, and  Serena Williams,  playing basketball in a makeshift court.  The humorous ad showcases their playful competitiveness and impressive skills, culminating in an unexpected ending involving a Pepsi-fueled celebration. The focus is on the fun and lighthearted nature of the game and the celebrities' enjoyable interactions.

title: GI Joe Retaliation
description: The 2012 Super Bowl ad for G.I. Joe Retaliation showcases intense action sequences from the movie.  It features quick cuts of explosions, fighting, and the G.I. Joe team in various combat situations.  The ad is fast-paced and visually exciting, highlighting the film's action-packed nature.  Very little dialogue is used, relying instead on visual storytelling to generate excitement and anticipation for the movie's release. The overall tone is one of intense action and adventure.

title: Everyone
description: The 2012 MetLife Super Bowl ad, "Everyone," showcases diverse individuals and families from various walks of life – a firefighter, a teacher, a young couple, etc.  It emphasizes the importance of community and togetherness through quick cuts of everyday life moments. The ad highlights the feeling of belonging and interconnectedness, associating these sentiments with the MetLife brand.  It concludes with the MetLife logo and tagline, suggesting the company's role in providing financial security and support for everyone.

title: Just My Shell
description: The 2012 M&M's Super Bowl commercial, "Just My Shell," features the red M&M's candy character lamenting his candy shell's imperfections.  He's insecure about his appearance, constantly fixing his shell and comparing himself to other, seemingly 'perfect' candies.  The ad concludes with a message of self-acceptance: he learns to love his 'imperfect' shell and embraces his unique qualities. The humor comes from the anthropomorphic portrayal of the M&M's and its relatable message of self-esteem.

title: Heart
description: The 2012 Hyundai Genesis Super Bowl commercial, titled "Heart," showcases a young man's journey from childhood to adulthood, emphasizing the car's longevity and reliability.  The ad uses montage techniques, showing him growing up alongside the car, highlighting key life moments such as graduation and starting a family.  The focus remains on the car's enduring presence and implicit suggestion of its quality, reliability, and its role within the evolving family life.

title: Swamp People
description: The 2012 Super Bowl ad for the HISTORY channel's "Swamp People" showcases scenes of alligator hunting in the Louisiana bayou.  It features quick cuts of swamp hunters wrestling with large alligators, navigating treacherous swamps in boats, and using various tools and techniques. The overall tone is action-packed and dramatic, highlighting the danger and skill involved in alligator hunting.  The ad ends with the HISTORY channel logo and the show's title.

title: Fatherhood
description: The ETRADE Super Bowl 2012 commercial, titled "Fatherhood," depicts a heartwarming montage of a father's life with his daughter, from her birth to her college graduation.  The scenes are intercut with quick shots of the father's financial planning and investments, subtly suggesting ETRADE's role in securing his daughter's future. The ad ends with a shot of the daughter at graduation, implying the importance of long-term financial planning for major life milestones.  The overall tone is sentimental and positive, showcasing the connection between financial responsibility and family.

title: Confident You
description: The 2012 Cars.com Super Bowl ad, "Confident You," showcases diverse individuals in various life stages and situations, highlighting the ease and confidence Cars.com provides in car shopping.  The ad uses quick cuts and upbeat music to show people using the website on their phones and computers, finding the perfect car for their needs.  It emphasizes the simplicity and efficiency of the platform, aiming to portray a feeling of empowerment and control over the car-buying process.

title: Green Hell
description: The 2012 Cadillac ATS commercial, titled "Green Hell," showcases the car's performance capabilities on the Nürburgring race track in Germany.  The ad features fast-paced driving footage emphasizing the car's handling and speed through challenging turns and straightaways.  The focus is on the car's agility and power, with minimal dialogue or other distractions. The overall tone is one of excitement and high-performance driving.

title: Vampire Party
description: The 2012 Audi Super Bowl ad, "Vampire Party," features a group of vampires at a lavish party, struggling with modern inconveniences.  Their attempts at using everyday technology, like smartphones and a coffee machine, hilariously highlight the challenges of integrating older lifestyles with modern life. The humor culminates with a vampire struggling with a new Audi's keyless entry system, ultimately showcasing the car's advanced technology in a darkly comedic way.

The 2012 Chevrolet Super Bowl ad showcases a futuristic, sleek car design.  The ad emphasizes the car's advanced technology and performance capabilities through quick cuts of driving scenes and close-ups of the vehicle's features.  The overall tone is aspirational, suggesting a sense of progress and excitement about the future of driving.  There's minimal dialogue, relying instead on visual appeal and a driving soundtrack.

title: Adriana Lima
description: Supermodel Adriana Lima stars in this Teleflora Super Bowl commercial. The ad opens with Lima preparing a bouquet of flowers, transitioning to various scenes showcasing flower deliveries.  Romantic and heartwarming moments unfold as recipients react joyfully to their Teleflora flower arrangements. The commercial emphasizes the emotional impact of sending and receiving flowers, associating them with love, celebration, and connection.  The ad concludes with the Teleflora logo and website address.

title: G.I. Joe Retaliation
description: The Super Bowl advertisement for G.I. Joe Retaliation is a fast-paced action sequence showcasing various characters from the film.  It features explosions, intense fight scenes, and glimpses of the film's plot involving Cobra Commander and the G.I. Joe team. The ad emphasizes the movie's action-packed nature and the high-stakes conflict, aiming to generate excitement and anticipation for the film's release.  The overall tone is thrilling and energetic, highlighting the movie's visual spectacle.

title: The Dictator
description: The Super Bowl ad for Paramount Pictures' "The Dictator" features Sacha Baron Cohen as the film's titular character, Admiral General Aladeen.  The comedic spot shows Aladeen engaging in various outlandish and disruptive behaviors, including interrupting a serious news broadcast and generally causing chaos.  The ad relies heavily on Cohen's comedic persona to promote the film, showcasing clips of his antics from the movie. The overall tone is irreverent and humorous, highlighting the absurdity of the film's premise.

title: Status
description: The 2011 Chevy Cruze Super Bowl commercial, titled "Status," depicts a young man's journey from a somewhat awkward, less confident persona to one of increased self-assurance and social standing.  This transformation is subtly linked to his acquisition of a Chevy Cruze. The ad uses a montage of scenes showing him interacting with friends and enjoying various activities, suggesting improved social status and confidence as a result of owning the car.  The overall tone is aspirational and subtly humorous, showcasing the car's association with a positive lifestyle upgrade.

title: Rio
description: The 2011 FOX Super Bowl ad, titled "Rio," uses vibrant animation to showcase the upcoming animated film 'Rio.'  The ad features quick cuts of colorful birds, lively music, and snippets of the movie's plot, highlighting the adventure and humor. It doesn't feature any celebrities or real-world footage, focusing entirely on promoting the film's visual appeal and exciting storyline. The overall message is one of fun and adventure, enticing viewers to watch the movie.

title: Tommy
description: The 2011 Chevy Silverado commercial, titled "Tommy," depicts a young boy, Tommy, embarking on a journey with his father in their Silverado pickup truck.  The journey is presented as a montage of various outdoor activities, emphasizing the truck's capability and reliability in diverse terrains and situations.  The focus is on the bond between father and son, and the shared experiences they create using the truck as a vehicle for adventure and family time. The ad ends with the Silverado driving off into the sunset.

title: Misunderstanding
description: The 2011 Chevy Cruze Super Bowl commercial, "Misunderstanding," depicts a series of humorous scenarios where people misinterpret the actions of others.  A man is mistaken for a dog walker, a woman is thought to be picking up trash, and a group are assumed to be a band.  The situations are resolved by showing the people all driving away in their new Chevy Cruzes, suggesting the car's unexpected appeal. The ad ends with the Chevy Cruze logo and tagline.

title: Kid in a Candy Store
original_title: 2011 CARMAX – Kid in a Candy Store
description: The 2011 CarMax Super Bowl commercial, "Kid in a Candy Store," depicts a young boy overwhelmed by the sheer volume of cars available at a CarMax lot.  He runs around excitedly, marveling at the variety of makes and models,  comparing them to candy. The ad uses playful, childlike wonder to highlight the extensive selection and seemingly endless choices CarMax offers its customers.

title: Defying Logic
description: The 2011 BMW Super Bowl ad, "Defying Logic," showcases a series of seemingly impossible feats achieved by a BMW driver.  The scenes are surreal and stylized, featuring a car effortlessly navigating impossible terrain and defying the laws of physics.  The ad emphasizes the car's capabilities and advanced technology through a series of visually stunning and improbable stunts.  The overall tone is one of awe and wonder, highlighting the BMW's exceptional performance and control.

title: Ozzy and Bieber
description: The 2011 Best Buy Super Bowl commercial features Justin Bieber and Ozzy Osbourne in a split-screen scenario.  Bieber is shown meticulously setting up a home theater system, while Ozzy is depicted in a chaotic, rock-and-roll environment.  The humor comes from the contrast between their personalities and approaches.  The ad highlights Best Buy's role in providing technology for diverse lifestyles and entertainment preferences, suggesting that whether you're a pop star or a rock legend, Best Buy has what you need.

title: The Force
description: A young boy dressed as Darth Vader uses the Force to perform various actions around the house, culminating in him starting his father's Volkswagen Passat. The ad uses humor and cinematic techniques, portraying Vader's attempts to manipulate everyday objects with unexpected results.  The father's amused reaction and the final reveal of the car as the source of Vader's power create a lighthearted and memorable moment.

title: Fast Five
description: The 2011 Super Bowl ad for Universal Pictures' Fast Five showcases action-packed scenes from the movie.  High-octane car chases, explosions, and Vin Diesel's character, Dom Toretto, are prominently featured.  The trailer emphasizes the film's thrilling plot and intense action sequences, aiming to generate excitement and anticipation for the movie's release.  Quick cuts and dramatic music underscore the intensity of the action.

title: Thor
description: The Super Bowl ad for Marvel's Thor showcases scenes from the upcoming film. It features dramatic shots of Thor, his hammer Mjolnir, and other characters.  The trailer highlights action sequences, glimpses of the Asgardian world, and hints at the plot involving Thor's banishment to Earth. The overall tone is epic and exciting, aiming to generate anticipation for the movie's release.

title: Empower the People
description: The 2011 Motorola Super Bowl commercial, "Empower the People," showcases a diverse group of individuals using Motorola technology in various settings.  It emphasizes connectivity and empowerment through quick cuts showing people using Motorola phones for communication and collaboration, highlighting the phone's capabilities in different contexts. The ad features everyday people rather than celebrities, focusing on the accessibility and utility of the product across various demographics.  It culminates in a shot of many people connected, symbolizing the power of communication and Motorola's role in it.

title: Logging with Richard Lewis and Roseanne Barr
original_title: 2011 SNICKERS – Logging with Richard Lewis and Roseanne Barr
description: The commercial features Richard Lewis and Roseanne Barr as lumberjacks, showcasing their irritable and argumentative personalities.  Their conflict escalates with increasingly absurd logging mishaps.  The humorous tension is resolved when one of them eats a Snickers bar, instantly transforming into a calm and helpful individual. The ad highlights how Snickers can alleviate mood swings and improve behavior, implying that hunger causes irritability.

title: Best Fans Ever
description: The 2011 NFL Super Bowl ad "Best Fans Ever" showcases a montage of passionate football fans from various backgrounds and locations.  It highlights the diverse and enthusiastic fanbase, depicting celebrations, tailgating, and game-day experiences. The video emphasizes the unifying power of football and the strong emotional connection fans have with their teams.  The ad features quick cuts of jubilant fans, emphasizing their energy and excitement.

title: The Breakup with Kim Kardashian
original_title: 2011 SKECHERS – The Breakup with Kim Kardashian
description: The 2011 Skechers Super Bowl ad features Kim Kardashian breaking up with her boyfriend.  The boyfriend, upset, throws her belongings out the window.  However, the items are all Skechers shoes and accessories. The ad highlights the comfort and style of Skechers, culminating in Kim expressing regret over the breakup and suggesting he keep the shoes.

title: “Imported from Detroit”
description: The 2011 Chrysler "Imported from Detroit" Super Bowl ad features Eminem rapping while showcasing the resilience and rebirth of Detroit and the Chrysler brand.  The commercial interweaves images of Detroit's industrial past and present with shots of Chrysler vehicles.  It emphasizes a message of hope and renewal for both the city and the automaker, associating Chrysler's quality with Detroit's strength and determination.

title: “Border”
description: The 2011 Coca-Cola Super Bowl ad, "Border," depicts a heartwarming scene of people from different countries coming together to share a Coca-Cola.  It showcases individuals from various cultures interacting positively, emphasizing unity and commonalities rather than differences.  The ad primarily utilizes visuals of people meeting and sharing a Coke, with a simple, feel-good message of global connection.

title: “Siege”
description: The 2011 Coca-Cola Super Bowl ad, "Siege," depicts a playful, action-packed scenario where a group of friends, armed with Coca-Cola, defend their stash from a relentless, comical onslaught by a horde of people desperate for a Coke.  The friends use creative tactics and teamwork to protect their precious cargo, highlighting the refreshing appeal of the beverage and the shared enjoyment it brings.

title: Pug Attack
description: The 2011 Doritos Super Bowl commercial, "Pug Attack," depicts a comical scenario where a group of pugs hilariously wreaks havoc on a seemingly peaceful suburban neighborhood.  The pugs, dressed in various outfits and carrying weapons like water pistols and slingshots, engage in a playful yet chaotic attack on unsuspecting residents.  The commercial relies on slapstick humor and cute animal antics to promote the Doritos brand.

title: Cowboys & Aliens
description: The Super Bowl ad for Universal Pictures' Cowboys & Aliens uses quick cuts of intense action scenes.  We see glimpses of cowboys, aliens, explosions, gunfights, and a spaceship.  The overall tone is exciting and suspenseful, designed to build anticipation for the film.  The ad relies heavily on visual spectacle to convey the movie's plot elements without extensive dialogue or exposition.  The title card appears at the end, emphasizing the movie's name.

title: Cram it in the Boot
original_title: 2011 MINI – Cram it in the Boot
description: The 2011 MINI Cooper ad, "Cram it in the Boot," showcases the car's surprisingly spacious trunk.  The video uses comedic exaggeration, showing various items—from a full-sized washing machine to a flock of sheep—being effortlessly loaded into the boot.  The ad highlights the MINI's unexpected storage capacity through absurd and humorous scenarios, emphasizing the car's practicality despite its compact size.

title: Love Hurts
description: The 2011 Pepsi Max Super Bowl commercial, "Love Hurts," features a romantic relationship depicted in a comedic and action-packed way.  A couple's escalating arguments culminate in a series of increasingly absurd and destructive events, showcasing their volatile relationship.  The commercial concludes with the couple, still arguing, enjoying Pepsi Max amidst the chaos. The humor derives from the exaggerated reactions and escalating situations that unfold, culminating in a humorous and unexpected resolution.

title: Limitless
description: The 2011 Relativity Media Super Bowl ad, "Limitless," is a fast-paced montage showcasing various scenes from their upcoming film releases.  Quick cuts of action, drama, and comedy highlight the diverse range of movies.  The ad features glimpses of actors and action sequences, emphasizing the thrill and excitement of the films.  The overall effect aims to create anticipation and build brand awareness for Relativity Media's film slate.

title: Xperia Ready to Play
original_title: 2011 SONY ERICSSON – Xperia Ready to Play
description: The 2011 Sony Ericsson Xperia ad showcases the phone's capabilities through quick cuts of various activities.  It features people using the phone in diverse settings, including a bustling city, a serene beach, and a lively party. The visuals emphasize the phone's integration into daily life and its ability to connect people and capture experiences.  Fast-paced editing and upbeat music underscore a sense of energy and immediacy, highlighting the phone's readiness for any situation.  There's no clear narrative, instead focusing on showcasing the device's functionality and lifestyle compatibility.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
original_title: 2011 MARVEL – Captain America: The First Avenger
description: The Super Bowl advertisement for Captain America: The First Avenger showcases scenes from the movie.  It highlights the transformation of Steve Rogers into Captain America, his intense training, and action-packed fight sequences. The trailer emphasizes the film's patriotic themes and thrilling superhero action, culminating in Captain America's iconic shield and stance.  The ad quickly builds anticipation for the film's release.

title: Baby Peas with will.i.am PT1
original_title: 2011 CHATTER.COM – Baby Peas with will.i.am PT1
description: The ad features will.i.am rapping about the benefits of Chatter.com, a social networking platform.  The setting is whimsical, with animated baby peas dancing and interacting with will.i.am. The rapper highlights the platform's features, emphasizing its ease of use and ability to connect people. The overall tone is upbeat and playful, aiming to attract a younger demographic to the platform.  The video focuses on the visuals and musical elements rather than explicit explanations of the platform's functionality.

title: Possibilities
description: The 2011 BMW Super Bowl commercial, "Possibilities," showcases a diverse range of individuals pursuing their passions.  A young boy practices his basketball skills, a woman practices ballet, and an older man meticulously crafts a violin. The ad emphasizes the potential and aspirations of everyday people, subtly linking these diverse pursuits to the capabilities and freedom associated with driving a BMW. It concludes with the tagline "The Ultimate Driving Machine." The ad is visually striking, using slow-motion shots and evocative imagery to create a sense of wonder and possibility.

title: Baby Peas with will.i.am PT2
original_title: 2011 CHATTER.COM – Baby Peas with will.i.am PT2
description: The ad features will.i.am rapping about Chatter.com, a social media platform.  He's in a whimsical setting with animated baby peas and uses quirky visuals to highlight the platform's features.  The overall tone is upbeat and playful, showcasing the ease of use and connectivity offered by Chatter.com.  The focus is on the quick and simple sharing features of the platform, emphasizing communication and connection.

title: Dog Sitter
description: A man is hired as a dog sitter for a group of dogs.  The dogs are quite rambunctious and cause chaos throughout the house and ultimately a party. The man, initially stressed, eventually joins in the fun. The ad concludes with Bud Light being enjoyed amidst the party atmosphere created by the dogs' antics.

title: One Epic Ride
description: The 2011 Kia Optima Super Bowl commercial, "One Epic Ride," follows a group of friends on a thrilling, action-packed journey.  Their adventure begins with a seemingly ordinary drive, but quickly escalates into a chase involving police cars, helicopters, and even a jump across a canyon.  The friends navigate various obstacles with humor and adrenaline, showcasing the Optima's capabilities and reliability amidst the excitement.  The ad concludes with the friends arriving at their destination, emphasizing the car's performance and the adventurous spirit it embodies.

title: Anachronistic City
description: The 2011 Hyundai Super Bowl commercial, "Anachronistic City," depicts a futuristic city where various historical figures and events are juxtaposed with modern technology.  We see a Roman chariot race alongside self-driving cars, knights battling robots, and a T-Rex roaming the streets alongside everyday commuters. The overall message subtly highlights the contrast between the past and future, suggesting Hyundai's innovative approach to automotive technology.

title: Hypnotized
description: The 2011 Hyundai Super Bowl ad, "Hypnotized," features a man seemingly hypnotized by a sleek, new Hyundai.  He performs unusual actions, such as effortlessly carrying heavy objects and reacting with exaggerated awe to the car's features. The commercial emphasizes the car's capabilities and design through the lens of this surreal, comedic hypnosis scenario.  The ad ends with the hypnotist suggesting the viewer should "test drive a Hyundai."

title: Deprogramming
description: The 2011 Hyundai Super Bowl commercial, "Deprogramming," depicts a man seemingly brainwashed into believing he's a robot.  He rigidly follows programmed actions until a Hyundai emerges, its features subtly altering his behavior, revealing his true, human self.  The ad uses humor to show how Hyundai's features break free from robotic routines and allow for more human experiences.

title: Black Beetle
description: The 2011 Volkswagen Black Beetle Super Bowl commercial showcases the car's sleek design and features through a series of quick cuts and dynamic shots.  A dark-colored Beetle is shown driving through various environments, emphasizing its stylish appearance and agility. The ad uses upbeat music and a fast-paced style to create excitement and a sense of adventure.  The overall message highlights the car's modern update and sporty appeal, contrasting it with the classic Beetle's heritage.

title: BumbleBee
description: The 2011 Chevrolet Super Bowl commercial features a yellow Camaro, nicknamed "Bumblebee", transforming from a beat-up car into a sleek, powerful machine.  The ad uses quick cuts and dynamic visuals to showcase the car's capabilities and stylish design.  The transformation is accompanied by energetic music, emphasizing the car's exciting and exhilarating nature.  The commercial concludes with the Chevrolet logo and tagline.

title: Release the Hounds
description: The 2011 Audi Super Bowl ad, "Release the Hounds," features a pack of meticulously groomed greyhounds bursting from their kennels and chasing a sleek, silver Audi R8 through a stylized, almost dreamlike landscape. The dogs' elegant pursuit highlights the car's speed and power, culminating in the Audi gracefully outmaneuvering the hounds.  The ad emphasizes the car's performance and design with a focus on visual spectacle rather than dialogue or narrative.

title: Smush
description: The HomeAway Super Bowl 2011 commercial, titled "Smush," depicts a family's chaotic but ultimately joyful vacation.  The ad uses fast-paced editing and humorous situations showing the family's various mishaps and close quarters while on vacation.  The overall message highlights the fun and memorable moments that can occur during family vacations, implying HomeAway rentals provide the space and flexibility for these experiences.

title: Parking Lot
description: The CareerBuilder Super Bowl 2011 commercial, titled "Parking Lot," depicts a series of increasingly absurd and humorous scenarios in a parking lot.  A man dressed in a monkey suit attempts to get into a car, followed by a series of strange occurrences involving a man dressed as a bear, a chimpanzee, and other unusual characters.  The ad highlights the often-unpredictable nature of hiring decisions and implies that CareerBuilder can help companies avoid hiring unsuitable candidates.

title: The Contract
description: The 2011 GoDaddy Super Bowl commercial, "The Contract," features Danica Patrick negotiating a contract with a GoDaddy employee.  The negotiation is playful and suggestive, with Danica ultimately agreeing to the deal, hinting at a hidden clause related to her revealing attire. The ad emphasizes GoDaddy's website building services in a humorous, attention-grabbing way. The overall tone is lighthearted, using sex appeal and humor to make the brand memorable.

title: The Reviews are In
description: The 2011 Cars.com Super Bowl ad, "The Reviews Are In," uses a montage of positive reviews from various sources (newspapers, magazines, and consumers) to highlight the website's trustworthiness and usefulness in car buying.  The ad features quick cuts of various car models and satisfied customers, emphasizing the breadth of choices and positive experiences offered through Cars.com. The overall tone is upbeat and confident, conveying the site's authority and reliability.

title: Go First
description: The 2011 Cars.com Super Bowl ad, titled "Go First," showcases a diverse range of people excitedly driving off in their newly purchased cars.  The commercial emphasizes the ease and convenience of using Cars.com to find the perfect vehicle.  Quick cuts show various makes and models, highlighting the website's vast inventory.  The overall message is one of empowerment and freedom associated with car ownership, facilitated by Cars.com's user-friendly platform.  The ad features upbeat music and a fast pace to maintain viewer engagement.

title: Logging Teaser Ad
description: The Snickers commercial opens with a lumberjack seemingly chopping down a tree with excessive force and precision, bordering on the absurd.  He then meticulously measures and examines the wood. The scene is hyper-serious and intense, contrasting sharply with the humorous, almost slapstick nature of his actions. The ad ends abruptly, leaving the viewer anticipating the resolution of the strange situation.  No product is explicitly shown.

title: Comfortable
description: The 2010 Dove Men+Care Super Bowl commercial depicts a series of everyday scenarios showing men in various situations.  It focuses on the comfort and softness of Dove Men+Care products.  Scenes include a man shaving, a father playing with his child, and a man working out. The overall message emphasizes that Dove Men+Care products allow men to feel comfortable and confident in their daily lives.

title: Samurai
description: A samurai warrior meticulously prepares a Doritos chip, using various martial arts techniques and tools.  The intense preparation culminates in a dramatic reveal of the chip, which he then dramatically eats. The ad relies heavily on visual humor through the contrast between the serious samurai demeanor and the mundane act of eating a chip.

title: Punxsutawney Polamalu
description: The TruTV Super Bowl ad, "Punxsutawney Polamalu," features Pittsburgh Steelers safety Troy Polamalu as Punxsutawney Phil.  The comedic spot opens with Polamalu emerging from a burrow, delivering a weather prediction in a humorous, slightly gruff manner.  The ad uses quick cuts, silly visuals, and Polamalu's iconic hair to create a funny contrast between the traditional Groundhog Day event and a football star.  The overall message is lighthearted and promotes TruTV's programming.

title: It Rocks, It Rocks
original_title: 2010 TACO BELL – It Rocks, It Rocks
description: The 2010 Taco Bell Super Bowl ad, "It Rocks, It Rocks," features a series of quick, humorous cuts showcasing various people enjoying Taco Bell products in diverse settings.  The ad emphasizes the speed and convenience of Taco Bell, with a focus on its late-night appeal.  The overall tone is lighthearted and energetic, utilizing rapid editing and catchy music to create a memorable and slightly absurd experience.  No specific products are heavily featured; instead, the focus is on the brand itself and its association with fun and satisfaction.

title: Little Bumps
description: The 2010 Michelob Ultra Super Bowl commercial, "Little Bumps," showcases a golfer's journey, highlighting minor setbacks (little bumps) throughout his game.  The ad emphasizes resilience and perseverance, ultimately culminating in a successful shot and a celebratory drink of Michelob Ultra.  The overall tone is lighthearted and aspirational, connecting the small challenges in golf to everyday life struggles.

title: Different
description: The 2010 KIA Sorento Super Bowl ad depicts a diverse group of individuals – a businessman, a family, a young couple – showcasing the versatility and adaptability of the vehicle to fit various lifestyles.  Each scene highlights a different aspect of the Sorento, emphasizing its spaciousness and functionality. The overall tone is upbeat and positive, associating the car with a sense of freedom and adventure. The ad uses quick cuts and various settings to maintain viewer engagement.

title: Chickens Across America
description: The Denny's "Chickens Across America" Super Bowl ad features a comedic montage of chickens in various American settings, engaging in human-like activities.  Chickens are shown driving cars, attending sporting events, and even participating in business meetings.  The overall message promotes Denny's as a place for everyone, playfully suggesting that even chickens enjoy their food. The ad is fast-paced, visually stimulating, and relies heavily on the unexpected humor of anthropomorphic chickens.

title: Chicken Warning
description: The 2010 Denny's Super Bowl commercial, "Chicken Warning," features a man in a chicken suit who repeatedly interrupts various scenes, such as a romantic dinner and a family gathering.  He warns people about the dangers of not eating Denny's Grand Slam breakfast, showcasing the breakfast in comical ways and emphasizing its value.  The chicken's insistent interruptions and the unexpected settings create a humorous and memorable advertisement.

title: Timothy Richman
description: The 2010 CARS.com Super Bowl commercial features Timothy Richman, a seemingly ordinary man, whose life dramatically improves after using the CARS.com website to find a car.  The ad showcases Richman's newfound confidence and success, including a glamorous date and a fancy car.  The humor lies in the unexpected transformation, suggesting that finding the right car through CARS.com can significantly impact one's life.

title: Stranded
description: The Bud Light "Stranded" Super Bowl ad from 2010 depicts a group of friends stranded in the desert after their car breaks down.  Their initial frustration and despair give way to resourceful problem-solving as they use their wits and a Bud Light to overcome their predicament.
